abstract: Aiming at the interference problems of sea clutter, clouds and bright bands on target detection in complex sea background, a target detection method based on Sea-Sky line is proposed. The method firstly obtains the edge image by gradient filtering and edge point optimization algorithm, and then detects the Sea-Sky line by the improved linear fitting method. The sea surface background is meticulously divided into three regions: sky, sea surface and Sea-Sky line by Sea-Sky line, and the sea surface target usually appears in the Sea-Sky line region first. Then the Sea-Sky line region is extracted as the target potential region, and the main noise interference in the sea surface and sky region is filtered out. Finally, filter smoothing and morphological operations are performed on the target potential region, and then the Canny algorithm is used to realize the detection of targets. The experimental results show that the proposed method improves the accuracy of Sea-Sky line detection, thus filtering out the main noise of the complex sea surface and realizing real-time target detection.

articleTitle: Analysis of Current Status of Monitoring and Maintenance Technology for Offshore Floating Wind Power Platforms
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: This paper conducts a survey and analysis of the current status of operation monitoring and maintenance technology for offshore floating wind power platforms. Globally, the transformation towards digitization and intelligence in manufacturing is driving rapid development of intelligent information monitoring and maintenance systems. By reviewing the technological accumulation and application of major manufacturers in areas such as digital twin models and remote monitoring technology, the paper emphasizes the importance of intelligent monitoring and maintenance systems for offshore floating wind power platforms. With the introduction of China's 14th Five-Year Plan, intelligent monitoring methods are gradually evolving towards multidisciplinary modernization, offering more possibilities for operation monitoring and maintenance of offshore floating wind power platforms. The paper also prospects the future development trends of intelligent maintenance, emphasizing the potential application value of technologies such as digital twin, artificial intelligence, and internet platforms in the maintenance of offshore floating wind power platforms.

articleTitle: A Supervised Clustering Approach for Customer Segmentation in Commercial Banks based on Customer Value
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: Customer segmentation is an essential aspect of customer management for commercial banks. In industrial applications, it is expected that customer segmentation will not only be utilized to classify users with similar characteristics into the same customer segment, but also to distinguish them as clearly as possible based on a specific indicator such as customer value. However, the majority of methods are unsupervised, such as K-Means, which makes it difficult to control the customer value differentiation of the clustering results. To address this issue, we propose a novel Customer-Value-Oriented Supervised Clustering method (CVOSC) to improve the distinctiveness of customer value among different customer segments. To our knowledge, this is the first time that the supervised clustering method has been applied to customer segmentation for commercial banks. We also introduce a new metric, Value DBI, which helps measure the distinctiveness of customer values across clusters. Through sufficient experiments conducted on a large real dataset, we substantiate that the results obtained from CVOSC exceed the traditional methods significantly.

articleTitle: Improving the PCA-based Chiller Sensor Fault Diagnosis with Relative Contribution
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: Built environment system focused on creating the suitable indoor air quality, while consuming a great deal of energy. Sensors played key role for monitoring the current real situation for HVAC&R equipment and system. More and more machine learning algorithms were implemented to maintain the optimal operation for the built environment systems and devices. Among them, Principe Component Analysis, as one of the most useful unsupervised machine learning algorithms, was widely employed to diagnose the abnormal sensor for chiller. However, the complete decomposition contributions could not correctly finding the faulty sensor due to its non-largest corresponding contribution. The relative contribution were employed to diagnose the abnormal one according with the rate between the contribution and its expect. Validated by the dataset of ASHRAE RP-1043, results showed that the relative contribution worked well even with the faulty server level of ±0.5°C for the cooling water out temperature sensor.

articleTitle: Research into an intelligent logistics handling robot based on front-end machine vision
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: The rapid development of e-commerce is forcing the logistics industry to become more efficient and intelligent. Conventional handling focuses on simple and repetitive point-to-point handling tasks taught by demonstration, where placement and gripping points are strictly required. In this paper, we take the handling robot as the experimental platform and study the robotic arm control method based on machine vision, which identifies and locates the target object by machine vision, and then controls the robotic arm to accurately grasp the target, so as to achieve the flexible handling operation task. Through image recognition, path planning, object grasping and other functions, it realizes autonomous navigation and cargo handling tasks for robots in complex environments. The application of multi-size fusion based image recognition test experiments showed that the test is close to the real annotation, thus facilitating image recognition and intelligent storage.

articleTitle: Study on Gamma Spectrometer Design of Wide Dose Rate Range
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: Most of spectrometers can only measure energy spectrum of low dose rate radiation because of their large detector volume and low speed of multi-channel analyzer. However, if nuclear accident occurs, the dose rate range will be very wide. Dose rate in nuclear contaminated zone is high, but it is low in non-contamination area. Measurement of different dose rate radiation needs different dose rate spectrometer. Current spectrometer cannot meet the need of nuclear emergency monitoring and rescue. If there are no high dose rate range spectrometers, the nuclear accident would be difficult to be assessed accurately. In this paper, a wide dose rate range gamma spectrometer based on detectors delay and high speed digital multi-channel analyzer is put forward. In this spectrometer design, some effective measures to widen the dose rate range of the spectrometer are taken. Analysis and design show that the design is feasible, and the dose rate range of the spectrometer can be heighten much more, and spectrum of most of wide dose rate range radiation can be detected with this spectrometer.

articleTitle: Research on application detection method of bolt vibration time-frequency analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: In the field of petroleum production detection, precise bolt vibration time-frequency analysis technology can simultaneously display the localized characteristics of the signal in the time domain and frequency domain. However, detection signals in industrial processes are often nonlinear and non-stationary. This article uses and compares four time-frequency analysis methods: short-time Fourier transform (STFT), wavelet transform, generalized S transform and Wigner-Ville distribution. The source of the data in this article is the measured data of the vibration detector of the oil fracturing pump truck. Through the analysis of the measured data results, it is found that the generalized S transform has relatively good time-frequency focusing and good cross-term suppression. In order to verify the breadth, this paper simultaneously analyzes the time-frequency results of three sets of data of the x, y, and z axes of the three-axis measurement channel. Through analysis, the superiority of the generalized S transform in processing bolt vibration signals is verified.

articleTitle: Design and Research of Adaptive Filter Microservices Based on Cloud-Native Architecture
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: The aim of this paper is to explore the design and implementation of an adaptive filter microservice based on cloud-native architecture. By leveraging the advantages of cloud-native technologies, such as containerization, automated deployment, and scalability, we design an adaptive filter microservice that is high-performance, flexible, and easy to manage. The service is able to dynamically adjust filter parameters based on real-time data to meet the needs of different application scenarios.

articleTitle: Based on CEEMD-LSTM Satellite Navigation Induced Deception Jamming Suppression Scheme
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: With the complexity and diversity of navigation spoofing signal attack strategies, how to effectively eliminate spoofing interference signals becomes very important. Based on (Empirical Mode Decomposition, EMD) and (Support Vector Machine, SVM), it has been proved that it can effectively process mixed signals with noise to obtain real satellite navigation signals. However, the EMD-based decomposition algorithm is prone to modal aliasing problems when decomposing signals, thereby reducing the suppression performance of deception signals. Therefore, this paper proposes a deception jamming signal suppression method based on complementary ensemble empirical mode decomposition and long-term and short-term memory network combination model. The method uses (Complete Ensemble Empirical Mode Decomposition, CEEMD) to decompose the received mixed navigation signal into IMF components with different characteristics, and establishes LSTM network models for the decomposed subsequences to predict. Finally, the real signal is accumulated according to the prediction results to eliminate the influence of deception signals. Theoretical analysis and simulation results show that compared with the spoofing interference suppression algorithm based on subspace orthogonal projection, this method can effectively eliminate induced spoofing interference, and its performance is better than the traditional EMD-SVM scheme. In addition, the algorithm eliminates spoofing signals at the signal level and has certain versatility.

Author Keywords: empirical mode decomposition of complementary set

articleTitle: Parallel Transformer-CNN Model for Medical Image Segmentation
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: In recent years, methods based on deep learning have made significant progress in the field of medical image segmentation, especially the method combining Transformer with Convolutional Neural Network (CNN). However, the existing hybrid models usually stack the Transformer module after convolutional layers, forming a serial structure. In this structure, CNN is first responsible for extracting the local features of the image, and then these features are passed into Transformer for extracting global information. Although this design combines the advantages of both to some extent, there is a problem in this serial structure that Transformer may not fully utilize the local features extracted by CNN when integrating global information, resulting in the loss of information in the transmission process , affecting the accuracy of segmentation. In addition, medical equipment often has certain limitations, and the number of model parameters cannot be too large. Therefore, in response to the mentioned problems, we present a novel model that combines Transformer and CNN in a parallel manner; a Hierarchical Feature Fusion (HFF) block is specially designed to effectively merge feature information from the two branches; A lightweight decoder is proposed, this decoder not only integrates the different scale features from the encoder, but also reduces the number of model parameters and improves training efficiency.

articleTitle: LIGHT: Language-Infused Graph Representation Learning Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: When dealing with the task of node classification on text-attributed graphs, the quality of the data is critical to the performance of the algorithm. However, in real-world application scenarios, researchers often face challenges such as data diversity, semantic diversity, and text length variations. Especially in professional fields such as healthcare and finance, where high-quality data acquisition is costly and complex. Therefore, When the existing data is not enough to meet the needs, data preprocessing or data enhancement are required. Traditional feature extraction methods are often difficult to capture deep semantic relations and context information. Pre-trained language models have made significant progress in augmenting node representations, but their performance is similarly limited in the presence of limited data. This paper proposes a new algorithm called LIGHT (Language-Infused Graph Representation Learning Networks). LIGHT combines the strengths of Large Language Model (LLM), Language Model (LM) and Graph Neural Network (GNN), aiming to solve the problem of insufficient semantic information present in node classification tasks. LIGHT adopts a two-layer language model structure. The bottom layer of the LIGHT focuses on understanding and generating node text descriptions to capture rich text information. The top layer model converts the underlying information into node features for use by the graph neural network. Through experiments on the ogbn-arxiv dataset, we demonstrate the effectiveness of LIGHT in handling textual node classification tasks.

articleTitle: Optimisation of Random Forest Algorithm Based on Data Mining Analysis and Sparrow Search Analysis of the Impact of 'BM Innovative Thinking System' on Innovation and Entrepreneurship Education in Colleges and Universities
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: Artificial intelligence-generated content based on big language models has been widely used in marketing, customer service, education, entertainment, news and other fields. Business English programmes need to be integrated with innovation and entrepreneurship education to help students hone their international communication skills and innovative thinking to better meet the challenges of the modern business world. The BM Innovative Thinking System developed in this paper is a web-based software based on artificial intelligence methodology designed to help undergraduate students in Chinese higher education institutions train in innovative and entrepreneurial thinking. The system employs advanced algorithms and technologies that can automatically adjust the learning content and difficulty based on user input and feedback to achieve optimal learning results. In this study, we investigated the role of practical projects in business English courses in improving innovation and entrepreneurship-related competencies and collected self-assessment data from a total of 1205 students. One-way ANOVA showed that there was a significant difference between the pre and post data, i.e., students believed that their innovative and entrepreneurial competencies were significantly improved through the course. The paper also develops a random forest algorithm optimised on the basis of an improved sparrow search algorithm that can predict students' experiences after using the innovative thinking system. In this paper, the model was trained and tested using relevant data, and the confusion matrices in the training and test sets show that the accuracy of the four classifications in the training set is 100%, and the accuracy of the four classifications in the test set is 96.26%, which can well predict the students' experience after using the system. This result has some reference value for the development of business English course design and practice programme.

articleTitle: Design of Plant Growth Lamp Control System Based on Convolutional Neural Network and Fuzzy Control
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: Currently, Plant growth lights require manual setting of the light intensity based on the growth status of plants, combined with work experience, to meet the growth needs of plants.This method incurs high labor costs and low operational efficiency. At the same time, the lighting environment is nonlinear, with many uncertain factors,leading to relatively low control accuracy. In response to these issues, a plant growth lamp control system has been designed that integrates convolutional neural networks and fuzzy control algorithms. The system collects data on plant growth conditions and environmental parameters using cameras and light intensity sensors. It employs a convolutional neural network model to automatically detect the growth status of the plants. Upon detecting the current state, it retrieves the corresponding optimal light intensity requirements from a data table. Subsequently, a fuzzy controller adjusts the light intensity of the plant growth lamps autonomously, thus achieving a high level of automation and improved control precision. By implementing precise control, this system aims to enhance both the quality and yield of the plants.

articleTitle: Face-parsing-constrained CycleGAN for Personalized Facial Paper-cut Generation
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: Facial paper-cutting, a cherished aspect of Chinese folk art, is facing the risk of diminishing due to the complexities of manual creation and the time-consuming production process. This paper proposes a novel approach for generating facial paper-cuts by employing a CycleGAN constrained by face parsing. Given the fundamental attributes of facial paper-cuts—minimalist design and intentional feature exaggeration—direct application of CycleGAN may lead to inaccuracies in facial features and unintended shadow effects. An attention mechanism, integrating facial semantic segmentation with channel attention, is introduced to refine the generator’s output. Comparative evaluations reveal that this method produces facial paper-cuts of superior quality compared to existing techniques. This novel approach has the potential to preserve and promote the unique art of Chinese papercut in the digital age.

articleTitle: Linguistic-Guided Feature Refinement For One-Stage Visual Grounding
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: Visual grounding is a challenging multimodal task that aims to locate object instances based on provided natural language expressions. Existing methods extract visual feature maps independently using pre-trained backbones, and then engage in cross-modal interaction through a post-fusion approach. We argue that such a post-fusion mechanism fails to fully exploit the information contained in both modalities. Furthermore, the visual features extracted by the pre-trained backbone often diverge from those required for effective multimodal reasoning, as the backbone tends to be influenced by a priori knowledge derived from object recognition tasks. In this paper, we propose a semantically-modulated refinement framework that uses linguistic information from the outset to guide the extraction of visual features, thereby addressing the problem of inconsistency. Our framework comprises a language-modulated visual encoder, a refined feature pyramid network (FPN), and a grounding module. Extensive experiments on four common datasets demonstrate the effectiveness and advanced performance of our proposed method.

articleTitle: Human Pose Estimation Combined with Transformer for Spatiotemporal Representation Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: At present, the methods of dynamic human pose estimation have some problems, such as inadequate extraction of human pose features and inadequate capture of time information of pose features. To solve the above problems, we propose a human pose estimation method combined with Transformer for spatiotemporal feature representation. Firstly, multi-head attention module in Transformer is redesigned, and local and global multi-head attention relationship aggregation modules are designed in shallow layer and deep layer respectively. Secondly, in order to exchange information between different Windows and extract deeper features, a 3×3 deep convolution module is added to the Feed-Forward Network. Then, combined with high resolution network HRNet, dynamic position embedding (DPE) is introduced to ensure the flexibility of the input sequence. Finally, we obtain an average accuracy of 77.5% on the MS COCO 2017 pose estimation task, 97.7% and 76.7% on UCF101 and HMDB51 dynamic human pose estimation datasets, respectively. Experiments show that the proposed algorithm is superior to other algorithms in performance and its effectiveness is verified.

articleTitle: Research on Industrial Control Network Security Data Feature Extraction Technology Based on Composite Sparse Autoencoder
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: Nowadays, industrial control system networks generate massive network communication data during their operation, characterized by large volume, diverse attributes, significant noise, rapid changes, and strong sparsity. Effectively and rapidly identifying network attack features from this data poses a challenging problem. This paper explores a dimensionality reduction model for network security big data, conducts an analysis of network security data features under the context of big data, and proposes a method for extracting industrial control network security data features based on a composite kernel sparse autoencoder. This method proves to be effective in enhancing the recognition rate of network security feature extraction.

articleTitle: Intelligent pharmacy management system based on computer vision technology and new medicine delivery robot
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: According to the analysis of the research level of "smart pharmacy" at home and abroad, the research level of "smart pharmacy" in China is relatively backward, and the construction method of "smart pharmacy" is single and the popularity rate is low. At present, most of the primary medical institutions in our country still adopt the traditional pharmacy or HIS system pharmacy management mode, and a small number of large hospitals use automatic drug dispensing machine with rail transportation to improve efficiency. However, due to the disadvantages of high cost, large space and low flexibility, this method is not suitable for the vast majority of primary medical institutions in China. In the face of the current social form, the team analyzes and designs according to the needs of users, and uses artificial intelligence, Internet of Things and other technologies to create a smart pharmacy management system that combines intelligent prescription management, intelligent prescription management, and intelligent drug management to meet the market demand and promote the development of the industry.

articleTitle: Image Smoothing Method Based on Image Segmentation and Local Constraint
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: The gradients of similar textures exhibit significant differences under different backgrounds, making it challenging for existing global image smoothing methods to completely remove them. Sub-region smoothing methods can better remove textures, but the smoothed images often exhibit seams. Therefore, this paper proposes a smoothing method based on image segmentation and local constraints. First, the method removes the main texture details from the entire image. Due to the very similar features between some structural edges and textures, this paper proposes a new local constraint filter to effectively remove complex texture details. Additionally, to avoid seams, this paper introduces an edge-constrained image segmentation method, segmenting the image based on major structural edges. Compared to existing methods, our method is effective in preserving weak structural edges and suppressing multiscale textures.

articleTitle: Long-term and Short-term Interest Sequential Recommendation with Periodicity and Interactivity
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: In real-world recommendation scenarios, the subsequent actions of user are shaped by enduring stable preferences and fleeting dynamic needs. However, most existing recommendation algorithms only consider one's short-term or long-term preferences, neglecting to integrate these two facets of information in an effective way. To this end, this thesis proposes a long-term and short-term interest recommendation model that integrates periodic interactive information. Specifically, the proposed model leverages one's periodic interaction data to enrich the representation of long-standing preferences. Additionally, a multi-head self-attention network is employed to capture one's fleeting interests, and an attention mechanism is utilized to seamlessly integrate both long-standing and fleeting interests, thereby delivering personalized recommendations. PILSAN performs better than present methods, according to experimental results, which are based on the evaluation of the model on two public datasets.

articleTitle: Single Acceleration Sensor Gyroscope-free Vehicle Inertial Dead Reckoning
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: According to vehicle’s movement, the paper put forward an idea of Single Acceleration sensor Gyroscope-free Vehicle inertial navigation System used in vehicle inertial track calculation, which can simplify the configuration of inertial navigation system. The paper derived the relationship among the vehicle’s travel path, the velocity and the lateral acceleration, and simplified the algorithm based on the vehicle’s movement on horizontal road, then verified the conclusion with actual road test. Based on all this, the paper made a further calculation of vehicle’s travel path and made a comparison with actual path after kalman filter, the result show the effectiveness of single acceleration sensor gyroscope-free vehicle inertial navigation. This article also made an analysis on this result and put forward the main problems in further research.

articleTitle: Flow Field Super-Resolution Method Based on Graph Neural Networks for Wing Profiles
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: The primary objective of flow field super-resolution technology is to enhance the resolution of flow field data while simultaneously reducing computational resource requirements through computational simulations and data processing methods. Building upon prior research, this study introduces a novel flow field super-resolution method composed of three essential components: an interpolation module, graph data preprocessing, and a graph neural network, referred to as RGHF. Within the interpolation module, the radial basis function interpolation method is employed. Furthermore, a pioneering graph convolution operation named GConv is introduced in the graph neural network and prediction modules. This approach effectively leverages low-resolution data to predict high-resolution data, resulting in reduced computational time while maintaining an acceptable level of precision. Experimental results on the RAE2822 airfoil dataset demonstrate an 81% reduction in computational time, along with robustness across varying flight conditions.

articleTitle: Continuous simulation method and case study based on AMEsim and Python
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: With the advancement of digital twin technology, there is a growing demand for model refinement and data processing speed, leading to common challenges in many digital twin projects. These challenges include issues such as multi-software interaction methods and achieving continuous simulation. For instance, in the context of rail transport, a high-speed trains digital twin project necessitates the utilization of AMEsim simulation for digital twin platform development. However, single simulation client does not support real-time data input. To tackle this issue, a continuous simulation method utilizing the Python programming language was devised for AMEsim. This method enables continuous assignment of signals to the simulation, ensuring that the final state of the simulation is accurately conveyed, thereby converting the simulation into multiple consecutive time slices. Experimental results affirmed that the proposed method effectively facilitates continuous assignments within AMEsim, thereby addressing a crucial problem of digital twin projects and enhancing convenience and flexibility for AMEsim users.

articleTitle: A Study on Monitoring Water Pollution Events Based on Natural Language Processing and Social Media
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: With the rapid development of social and economic development, China’s environmental development is also extremely rapid, but there is still the phenomenon of sudden water pollution of the environment, which not only affects the cleanliness of the river waters, but also directly affects the residents of the normal life of water. Under the big data environment, a large amount of relevant information generated by news platforms or social media platforms when various sudden events occur can provide data support for event detection and information acquisition. In this paper, we use the named entity recognition technology in natural language processing to build a BERT-BiLSTM-CRF model for water pollution event monitoring using tweets from social media platforms as data sources. The experimental results show that the model extracts F1 values up to 0.9119, and the extraction results can provide additional data support for the discovery and monitoring of water pollution events around the world.

articleTitle: Cloud Manufacturing Service Selection and Optimization Scheduling Method with Time-of-Use Electricity Price Constraints
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: Cloud manufacturing service selection and scheduling has received extensive attention in optimizing resource allocation and meeting user needs. Electricity consumption accompanies the entire life cycle of cloud manufacturing services. However, few existing studies on the selection and scheduling of cloud manufacturing services have considered the constraint of TOU. In order to reduce power cost and ensure service quality , a multi-objective optimization model for cloud manufacturing service selection and scheduling under TOU is established. An improved multi-objective Seagull optimization algorithm (MOISOA) is proposed to solve the problem of cloud manufacturing service selection and scheduling under time-of-use tariff (TOU). Experimental results show that MOISOA algorithm can obtain better solutions than many classical multi-objective algorithms.

articleTitle: Control of One-arm Robot Based on RBF Neural Network Model
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: A method which is controlling of single arm robot is proposed that accorded to RBF neural network model.RBF neural network,who is named radial basis function, that has input layer, hidden layer,output layer,and it is a feedforward layer who has a single hidden layer. It is nonlinear that the input set mapped to the output set, but it is linear that the hidden layer space mapped to the output space. Because the RBF network whose action function is Gaussian basis function , its output is related to some modulation parameters. In the input space who is limited , it is not zero, and it is a neural network method who has local approximation. Therefore, RBF network can learn quickly and avoid local minimal problems, and the real-time requirements of control can be satisfy . Through establishing the Simulink control system simulation of the relevant model and the discrete digital simulation of M fuction, the control method which used RBF neural network model is very accurate and real-time, and the control effect is very good.

articleTitle: Application of Stacking Model with Feature Weighting Method in Shale Gas Production Prediction
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: Shale gas is gaining attention as a non-traditional clean energy source. Predicting shale gas well production capacity is vital for production planning. Conventional methods struggle due to complex relationships between parameters. This study proposes a feature-weighted fusion and Stacking ensemble model. Using data from 242 gas wells, feature weights are calculated and applied to training/testing sets. Random Forest Regression, Support Vector Machine, and Light Gradient Boosting Machine models are used, with a Multilayer Perceptron model serving as the meta-learner. Results show the Stacking model significantly outperforms base learners in RMSE, MAE, and R-Square metrics, improving prediction accuracy and generalization. This research provides valuable insights for shale gas well production capacity prediction and production planning.

articleTitle: Detection of insulator defects in lightweight networks based on YOLO-V5s
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: The current deep learning algorithms mostly have problems with a large number of model parameters and high hardware requirements, which are difficult to embed in mobile devices such as drones. In order to detect the defects of the insulators in the overhead transmission line, an improved YOLOv5 insulator defect detection method is proposed. This method first introduces the MobileNet-V3 lightweight network module on the original YOLOv5 skeleton network. Then, to improve the model detection accuracy, the shuffle attention attention module was added to the backbone network, and the original feature fusion network PAN + FPN structure was replaced with a weighted two-way pyramid structure BiFPN. Finally, the SIOU function is introduced to improve the regression accuracy of the prediction frame, and the ablation experiments are set to verify the proposed method. The experimental results show that this method can identify the normal insulator, insulator flashover damage, improve the detection accuracy by 1.6%, 5.9% and 3.0% respectively, and improve the detection efficiency by 36.3%.

articleTitle: Research and Application of a Panoramic Observable Monitoring System for Service Status in Business Middle Platform of the New Power System
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: The power system is undergoing a transition from the traditional to new power system, the business middle platform acts as a pivotal element within the digital architecture of grid enterprises. By integrating data and services across the entire "generation-transmission-load-storage" process, it has facilitated centralized management and efficient utilization of corporate resources. However, with the burgeoning number of services provided by the business middle platform and its extensive application, the complexity of service invocation chains within the business middle platform has escalated dramatically. Ensuring the healthy and stable operation of services, pinpointing performance bottlenecks in service chains, and achieving an intuitive overview of the business middle platform’s overall status have become paramount issues. As a new phase in the evolution of monitoring systems, observable theories and technological practices offer fresh insights and strategies to enhance the quality of the business middle platform services. This research, based on observability technologies and principles, aims to implement a comprehensive, observable monitoring system tailored to the operational status of the business middle platform services. This system serves to observe and analyze the state of the business middle platform services effectively, thereby improving the quality of middleware services.

articleTitle: Heart Sound Classification Based on Two-channel Feature Fusion and Dual Attention Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: Heart sound signals serve as crucial indicators of cardiovascular health. Recent breakthroughs in deep learning have markedly improved the ability to analyze and classify these signals, offering significant advancements in the field. This progress not only bolsters diagnostic accuracy for healthcare professionals but also eases the strain on medical systems. Recognizing the limitation of current studies that primarily focus on either one-dimensional or two-dimensional heart sound features, this paper introduces a novel approach for heart sound classification utilizing a two-channel feature fusion and a dual attention mechanism. The methodology includes: (1) Employing a two-channel architecture to separately process and subsequently fuse both one-dimensional and two-dimensional features of heart sounds, thereby capturing both the dynamic and time-frequency information effectively. (2) Incorporating a dual attention mechanism to enhance the model's capacity to discern the relevance of various channels, utilizing a multi-head attention mechanism to concentrate on both the local and global aspects of the fused features. The proposed method demonstrates promising results, achieving an accuracy of 93.7% and an F1 score of 91.9%.

articleTitle: Pressure Equipment Status Data Cleaning Method Based on LSTM-VAE-GAIN
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: Improving status data quality for pressure equipment is crucial for efficiency and fault prediction. Traditional cleansing methods are ineffective due to reliance on complete datasets and single-pattern techniques. To tackle this, this paper proposes an advanced LSTM-VAE-GAIN method. Initially, the kernel function-based local outlier factor (KLOF) algorithm detects anomalies in incomplete datasets, marking them. Then, Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) and Generative Adversarial Imputation Networks (GAIN) are combined to train and impute missing data using anomaly labels. Additionally, LSTM and Variational Auto-Encoders (VAE) detect anomalies, correcting them with the imputation model. Experimental results show effectiveness in imputing missing data and identifying anomalies, enhancing pressure equipment status monitoring data quality.

articleTitle: Efficient VaCEI-based Non-myopic Bayesian Optimization For Constrained Black-Box Optimization
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: Constrained Bayesian Optimization (CBO) is an effective class of algorithms for solving optimization problems where both the constraint function and the objective function are expensive black-box functions. However, most current CBO algorithms are myopic, considering only the immediate gain from a single sampling without taking into account long-term rewards. Non-myopic CBO, employing an approximate dynamic programming (ADP) approach called "rollout" to simulate the impact up to the next h steps, can be used to address such problems. Nevertheless, obtaining the exact solution using this method incurs significant computational costs, with each sampling suggestion sampling taking several hours. In this paper, a computationally efficient non-myopic CBO is proposed, which can provide a sampling suggestion within a matter of minutes. Firstly, the variance adjustment parameters are introduced to control the exploration and exploitation behavior of Constrained Expected Improvement (CEI), a myopic CBO method. Secondly, the ADP approach "rollout" is used to determine the optimal variance adjustment parameters that maximize long-term rewards. Finally, the results of several numerical experiments and an antenna design problem indicate that the proposed algorithm outperforms the compared myopic CBOs in terms of convergence speed and accuracy.

articleTitle: Machine Learning-Based AC Resistance Model for Litz Wire Windings
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: Optimizing the AC resistance of litz wire windings is crucial for reducing loss and improving the efficiency of energy transfer in power systems. This study presents a novel method for obtaining the AC resistance of litz wire windings by using machine learning algorithms. It simplifies and improves the speed at which AC resistance values are obtained and facilitates the study of AC resistance parameters in litz wire windings. A simulation model is established using an approximate model for optimizing the AC resistance of litz wire windings based on the Dowell equation. Maxwell software is used to generate the training dataset. The frequency, dimensions, number of layers, and conductivity are used as input to the proposed machine learning model, while the AC resistance of litz wire windings is the output variable. A neural network is coupled with the particle swarm optimization method to optimize the network structure to achieve better results. The proposed machine learning model has a prediction accuracy rate of 99%.

articleTitle: Research on the Application of Machine Learning in Wet Waste Treatment Project
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: Among the various stages of wet waste treatment, anaerobic fermentation is particularly important. In this study, machine learning methods were employed to predict methane production using the random forest algorithm, and gas production was predicted using the gradient boosting tree algorithm. These predictive results will be fed back to the production process to improve processing efficiency. Data from the SCADA system were collected and cleaned, and normalized for model training. The experiments demonstrated that these machine learning models can provide accurate and reliable predictions.

articleTitle: Design of an Accessible Music Control Device for Individuals with Disabilities Based on Gesture Recognition
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: With the consistent advancement of science and technology, the quality of life for individuals has been continuously enhanced. However, due to their physiological limitations, individuals with disabilities have faced difficulties in obtaining equal level of welfare compared with others during the technological progress. In response to the above challenges, this essay will introduce an accessible music control device, which utilizes gesture recognition technology to help individuals with disabilities to lightly control the music software. The principle of this design is to transmit different gesture information (up, down, left, right, front, back, clock-wise, counterclockwise, and fluctuating) read by the gesture recognition sensor PAJ7620U2 to the Arduino Leonardo core processor through the I2C communication serial port. The software program run by the Arduino IDE (Integrated Development Environment) software drives the OLED 0.96 display, and then the recognized gestures will be displayed on the OLED 0.96 screen, enabling the tar-get group to use music software for volume adjustment, track switching and other essential functions.

articleTitle: Research on Connectionless Identity Authentication Method Based on National Cryptographic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: The conventional methods of identity authentication, such as passwords, tokens, and biometric features, typically necessitate users to establish an electromagnetic connection with the server during the authentication process. In order to effectively avoid the security risk of authentication information being attacked and intercepted in traditional authentication schemes, the article designs a connectionless identity authentication scheme based on the national cryptographic algorithm. In the absence of electromagnetic connection between the authentication party and the user, user identity authentication is completed through the coordination of QR code and national cryptographic algorithm. The article scheme has the characteristics of high security, simple principle, and low investment. Compared to traditional identity authentication schemes, it has more advantages in application scenarios such as information system login verification and non-contact access control.

articleTitle: Tracking Players in Volleyball Matches using Vol-Bot-SORT
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: The general tracking algorithm is deficient in the face of the problems of long-term occlusion and irregular movement between players in volleyball games. In this paper, on the basis of tracking players based on the YOLOv8 algorithm and the Bot-SORT algorithm, the effective tracking of players is realized by constraining the object of the Kalman filter, integrating the momentum feature and introducing the altitude state as a weak cue to adjust the IOU, and combining with the number of players constraints. Experimental results show that compared with Bot-SORT, our algorithm reduces the number of ID exchanges by 40% and the false detection rate by 97%, which effectively improves the tracking accuracy.

articleTitle: Attention-LSTM-Based Power Optical Distribution Frame Cable State Hierarchical Pre-Warning Model
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of the insufficient accuracy of pre-warning decision, this paper proposes a hierarchical pre-warning model based on Attention-LSTM prediction for the power optical distribution frame(ODF) cable. Firstly, the power ODF cable data prediction model is established based on the Attention-LSTM training network, and the power ODF cable loss prediction value is obtained through the SENet attention weighting and LSTM data prediction operation. Then, based on the K-means clustering model, the pre-warning and hierarchical decision of the operation status of power ODF cable is realized by using the power ODF cable loss data and multi-core parameters. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed model is verified by experiments. The experimental results show that, compared with the comparison method, the prediction accuracy index of the proposed method is improved by 2% on average, which can effectively realize the hierarchical pre-warning, so as to more efficiently complete the operation and maintenance of power ODF cable.

articleTitle: Application of column generation combined with pulse algorithm to Orienteering Problem with time windows
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: The Orienteering problem with time windows (OPTW) is a typical NP hard problem, with the increase of data scale, the computational time will increase explosively. Pulse algorithm is a novel depth first search algorithm, in this paper, column generation combined with pulse algorithm is applied to the OPTW, in which pulse algorithm as a sub problem algorithm in the framework of column generation algorithm to solve iteratively. The experimental results of the Solomon’s and Cordeau’s benchmark show that the column generation combined with pulse algorithm has higher accuracy and faster solution speed compared with other algorithms when solving different scale instances. Compared with the original pulse algorithm, the improved algorithm combined with column generation has obvious advantages in computing speed when solving complex and large-scale instances, and has certain research potential and application value.

articleTitle: Photo Management Assistant
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: In recent years, people's demand for photos has increased day by day, resulting in a situation where photo albums are numerous, miscellaneous and scattered. Looking for a photo of a certain person is like looking for a needle in a haystack. In addition, once the data information contained in the photos is illegally infringed and maliciously tampered with, it will cause heavy losses to individuals. In order to effectively manage photos in user albums and ensure the security of user photo storage and transmission, this article uses face detection, face clustering and encryption algorithms, and uses multi-threading and process pools to design a method that can process photos of people. A system for intelligent classification and encryption. The design and development of the photo classification and encryption system has high usability and can bring a good experience to users.

articleTitle: Application of Remote Virtual Reality Combined Experimental Platform in Integrated Operational Amplifier Experimental Teaching
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: At present, there are many learning resources about operational amplifiers, but because of the large gap between the practical application of integrated operations and the theory, and the easy loss of operational modules in laboratory teaching, students are unable to understand the applications of operational amplifiers in depth. Therefore, this article proposes a virtual simulation platform project to meet students' needs for learning basic principles and typical application cases through independent learning design. This teaching method fully solves the problem of transformation from theory to practice and builds a new experimental teaching model of experimental teaching flipped classroom. Through process-based assessment, not only students' experimental results are evaluated, but also whether students meet safety requirements and precautions during the experiment are also carefully assessed.

articleTitle: Research on Object Detection Algorithm Based on Coordinate Information Fusion and Spatial Perception
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: The extensive integration of deep learning within the domain of object detection has escalated the necessity for enhancing detection precision and spatial fidelity. The proposed YOLO-CA detection algorithm introduces two groundbreaking techniques: CoordConv and RoIAlign. Initially, CoordConv integrates the coordinate data of pixel locations into the convolutional neural network architecture, enabling the network to more effectively comprehend pixel-wise spatial relationships, thereby boosting performance in tasks involving spatial structures. Following this, RoIAlign is employed to address potential pixel misalignment issues associated with RoIPool, thereby escalating the spatial accuracy of the regions of interest. Empirical findings on the VOC dataset demonstrate a 0.025 increase in the mAP score for the refined model incorporating both CoordConv and RoIAlign, signifying substantial improvements in object detection performance. These innovations have been empirically validated to boost detection accuracy and spatial precision, offering novel insights and strategies for deep learning algorithms within the object detection realm, carrying both theoretical significance and practical implications.

articleTitle: Anti-forensics for JPEG decompression based on generative adversarial network
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: Eliminating artifacts left after decompression of JPEG images, especially those compressed at high quality factors, is a challenging issue in image anti-forensics. In this paper, JPEG decompression anti-forensics are modeled as an image-to-image translation problem, where a generative adversarial network framework is used to translate a JPEG decompressed image to a reconstructed one. Due to the introduction of chroma upsampling artifacts during image decompression, the difference distribution of odd and even pixel pairs on the chroma plane of the uncompressed and decompressed image is different. To solve this issue, we propose an odd-even chroma difference loss to recover this distribution difference. Experimental results show that the modified images generated by this anti-forensic method are able to deceive existing detectors and have excellent visual quality.

articleTitle: Research on Digital Commercial Illustration Design System Based on Computer Big Data
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: This paper introduces the method of computer graphics editing on NET platform. Several aspects of computer graphics generation, such as accompanying files, graphics processing and network interactive control, are studied. Through the secondary development of Arbortext Isoview, the intelligent hierarchical display, object management, event processing and animation generation based on Arbortext Isoview are completed. It can control and interact with CGM illustration in the network environment. At the same time, the mathematical model of illustration graph is established by using operator and clustering optimal gene algorithm. Firstly, hybridization and mutation probabilities were dynamically regulated according to population characteristics, thus improving the optimization speed in the evolutionary process. K-medoids method was used to cluster them. The cost function is used to evaluate the advantages and disadvantages of the cluster. An arbitrary graph rendering method based on genetic algorithm is proposed. The experimental results show that this method is more artistic and creative in illustration art design.

articleTitle: A Task Balance Control Method for Port Terminal Operations Ships Based on Particle Swarm Optimization Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: In order to improve the control effect of port terminal operation vessels, a task balancing control method for port terminal operation vessels based on particle swarm optimization genetic algorithm is proposed. Segmentation of multi temporal data of port terminal operation vessel tasks based on Trie tree; Constructing a multi-objective optimization model and constraint conditions for task balance regulation of port and dock operation vessels; Design particle swarm optimization genetic algorithm, solve the model, and achieve balanced control of port and dock operation vessel tasks. The experimental results show that the method has a lower control completion time and scheduling occupancy rate, while a higher success rate of control tasks, which improves the balance of ship task control in port operations.

articleTitle: Automatic Measurement System for Satellite Alignment
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: In order to improve satellite alignment efficiency, an automatic measurement system is designed, which mainly includes a two-dimensional guide rail system, a precision turntable, and an automatic theodolite assisted with a CCD camera. In this system, the theodolite can be automatically moved along the guide rail system by a motor to the theoretical position, so that its telescope optical axis can be perpendicular to the reflective surface of the optical reference on the precision equipment on the satellite. At the same time, the satellite is fixed on a precision turntable and can be turned around the table axis. Therefore, the optical surface on the satellite can be automatically collimated one by one by use of the theodolite. The yaw angle and pitch angle of each mirror normal direction relative to the theodolite coordinate are automatically recorded. Then, all mirror normal vectors can be transferred with respect to a common reference, and the angles between the normals can be calculated. Therefore, the pose matrix composed of the reference plane normals representing the device coordinate system can be obtained. In the system, in order to achieve automatic positioning of the theodolite, it is necessary to know the theoretical position of the measured equipment reference on the satellite and the initial position of the satellite relative to the guide rail. In order to achieve automatic collimation of the theodolite, a set of CCD cameras is installed on the theodolite eyepiece, which can be used to determine whether the theodolite is properly collimated. In the test, a 17-sided polygonal prism with calibration data is measured. The maximum difference between measurements and calibration data is 4.1 ″ and the stand deviation is 3.3″. The system has been employed to align the GF-2 satellite, and the assembly accuracy is guaranteed. It can satisfy the requirements of high precision and high efficiency.

articleTitle: Rotated Single-stage Detector with Transformer in Remote Sensing Rotating Object Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: The task of rotation object detection poses significant challenges in the field of computer vision due to difficulties in accurately separating objects from complex backgrounds and extracting features from small targets. In recent years, Transformer has emerged as a prominent technique in computer vision, featuring self-attention mechanisms capable of extracting target features. We propose a Multi-scale Feature Self-Attention Module based on Transformer, abbreviated as the ks module. We integrate this proposed module into the backbone and neck of the algorithm, a method less explored in the domain of Transformer-based improvements for rotation object detection. This approach combines Transformer's TransformerBlock and Feed-Forward Network (FFN) to hierarchically extract multi-scale features of remote sensing objects in complex environments, thereby achieving improved detection accuracy. Experimental results on popular datasets such as DOTA and HRSC2016 demonstrate that our proposed R3Det-ks outperforms current state-of-the-art methods in remote sensing imagery object detection.

articleTitle: Image Segmentation Method with Joint Loss Optimization for Apple Picking
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: In the process of automated apple picking, when depth estimation is performed based on the center position of the target detection candidate frame, errors may occur due to the influence of complex environments such as leaf occlusion and lighting changes. Therefore, this work proposes an image segmentation method with joint loss optimization for apple picking. This method automatically labels the collected apple data set to obtain accurate apple label files. Then, the BCEDice is used as the joint loss optimization function to balance the problem of sparse training gradients, and the processed apple data set is input into the autoencoding model, combining ResNet and UNet for training. Finally, experiments on the apple segmentation dataset showed that the model performed well on evaluation indicators, with the Dice coefficient and precision reaching 89.7% and 89.6%, respectively. This validation result shows that the model also exhibits good generalization ability and segmentation accuracy on the diverse apple dataset collected.

articleTitle: Depth Image Inpainting Algorithm Based on Improved Non-Local Means Filtering
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: Depth images captured by depth cameras often suffer from issues such as holes and noise, which can have adverse effects on subsequent practical applications, including the accuracy of 3D reconstruction. To address these issues and enhance the quality of depth images, we propose depth image restoration algorithm based on improved non-local means (NLM) filtering. Initially, the algorithm utilizes fuzzy C-means (FCM) clustering to cluster the color image and generate a guidance image. Subsequently, neighborhoods are defined centered around the hole points in the depth image. A weight function for NLM filtering is then constructed using bilateral filtering. By calculating the weighted average of all non-hole points within the neighborhood, the holes are repaired. Finally, median filtering is utilized to smoothen and reduce noise in the depth image. Experimental findings show that the proposed algorithm efficiently repairs holes while preserving the edge details of image.

articleTitle: Early Autism Spectrum Disorder Screening Based on Integrated Neural Networks and Scales
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: Quantitative checklist for autism in toddlers (QCHAT) is a more general screening tool for early autism spectrum disorder (ASD), but it is mostly manually determined in the assessment, and many complex situations cannot be judged. In recent years, deep neural network (DNN) architectures have been proven to perform well in dealing with complex problems, based on the idea of Bootstrap Aggregation (Bagging), a Multi-Channel Bagging Attention Tabular Network (MBAT-Net) for ASD screen is proposed and attempts to identify ASD patients from QCHAT datasets in this paper. Two datasets were used in this study: QCHAT and QCHAT-10 to train and evaluate the model performance, and finally achieved 97.20% accuracy on QCHAT and 100% on QCHAT-10. The proposed framework is then compared with existing research methods, and the results showed that it effectively improved the early screening accuracy of ASD, and could provide a more reliable automated tool for early ASD diagnosis.

articleTitle: Ontology-based Vulnerability Knowledge Graph of Network Routing Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: Knowledge graph is essentially a visual way to present knowledge, which can explore the relationship between knowledge, so as to reveal the dynamic development law of knowledge in specific fields, and realize the sharing and reuse of knowledge. Therefore, the establishment of vulnerability knowledge graph can provide comprehensive and in-depth information support for subsequent vulnerability analysis, which has important theoretical and practical application value. In this paper, by analyzing the vulnerability of the routing mechanism of the space-based network, we designed a fault injection experiment scheme for the typical routing program, realized the dynamic collection of the vulnerability feature information of the network routing mechanism, and constructed the vulnerability dataset of the network routing mechanism. After that, we designed the network routing mechanism vulnerability knowledge graph pattern layer, established the routing mechanism vulnerability ontology model, and finally formed the space-based network routing mechanism vulnerability knowledge graph. The vulnerability knowledge graph of space-based network routing mechanism proposed in this paper has the advantages of visualization and integrity.

articleTitle: Deep Transmission Estimation Based on Dark Channel Prior for Low-light Image Enhancement
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: This paper proposes a novel method, transmission parameter estimation network (TPENet), which aims to address the lack of adaptivity in luminance improvement when applying the dark channel defogging model for low-light image enhancement. TPENet studies a parameter mapping which adaptively adjusts the enhancement degree of each pixel in the image. In addition, a self-regularization mechanism (SRM) is introduced to weight the parameter mapping according to the average luminance level of the input image to achieve macro-adaptive adjustment. Finally, a series of meticulously constructed non-reference loss functions optimizes luminance, chromaticity, and spatial coherence. Extensive experimental data show that the TPENet has excellent performance in terms of luminance, chroma, and naturalness, as well as good generalization and robustness over multiple datasets.

articleTitle: Vehicle-Assisted Computing Offloading for UAV Enabled Crowdsensing
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: Unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV)-assisted mobile crowdsensing, as a promising mobile crowdsensing paradigm to support various of mobile applications, has attracted a great deal attention of academic and industrial. However, there still exist challenges for UAV-assisted crowdsensing due to intensive computation involved in sensing tasks, limited energy consumption and computing power. In this paper, we propose a vehicle-assisted computing offloading scheme for UAV enabled crowdsensing. Specifically, the UAV motivates vehicles to contribute idle computational resources to participate in the UAV’s computational offloading task by offering rewards. Then, a reverse auction model is established to analyze the interaction between the UAV and vehicles, where their utilities are formulated in detail. Finally, extensive experiments have been conducted to validate the proposed scheme. The simulation results show that the proposed scheme can achieve higher utilities of the UAV and vehicles compared with conventional schemes.

articleTitle: Detection of Traffic Signs Based on Lightweight YOLOv8n
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: To enhance the real-time response capability and practicality of traffic sign detection, this paper innovatively proposes a lightweight traffic sign detection model based on YOLOv8n. The design of this model is unique and ingenious. Firstly, we cleverly integrate the BiFormer attention mechanism based on the Transformer architecture into the C2f network structure of YOLOv8n. This measure significantly enhances the model’s ability to detect small targets, not only improving detection accuracy but also effectively reducing the number of model parameters. Furthermore, in pursuit of higher detection accuracy, we introduce the Content-Aware Re-Assembly of Features (CARAFE), a universal, lightweight, and efficient operator. Its addition injects new momentum into the improvement of model performance. Additionally, we replace the original CIOU loss function with Wise-IOU, which not only improves detection speed but also further optimizes accuracy. Through a series of carefully designed experimental verifications, we find that the improved algorithm exhibits excellent performance on both the public traffic sign dataset CCTSDB and the small target dataset FLOW-IMG. Specifically, its detection accuracy reached up to 96.8% on the CCTSDB dataset and 84.9% on the FLOW-IMG dataset, representing an increase of 1.8% and 4.8% respectively compared to the original algorithm. At the same time, the number of model parameters has been reduced by 10%, further enhancing its practicality and efficiency.

articleTitle: An Anomaly Detection Method Based on Meta-Path and Heterogeneous Graph Attention Network
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: Advanced Persistent Threats (APT) in the current network environment are becoming increasingly complex and diverse. Most existing APT anomaly detection is based on attack knowledge bases and preset rules, which are difficult to design and cannot make good use of the rich semantic information in the original log data. This results in poor detection of unknown attacks. This paper proposes an anomaly detection method based on meta-path and heterogeneous provenance graph. We design a heterogeneous graph structure to represent provenance graph, and define the meta-paths of the PROCESS nodes. Then we use Heterogeneous Graph Attention Network (HAN) to learn the embedding representation of the nodes based on meta-paths. The resulting graph’s node embedding is used as node features, and then we apply SVDD algorithm to identify anomalous nodes. A series of experiments were conducted on the Unicorn SC-2 dataset to validate the proposed method. The final results demonstrate that our method outperforms two current anomaly detection systems.

articleTitle: Classification of Aging Grade of Heat-resistant Steel based on Improved Shufflenet Network
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: Heat-resistant steel is important material for manufacture of power generation equipment. The aging grade of heat-resistant steel has an important impact on whether the equipment can operate safely. The aging grade of heat-resistant steel needs to be judged according to metallographic images of material during on-site inspection. However, traditional manual classification method has high requirements for experience, an improved shuffle net network is proposed in this paper, which can automatically and accurately classify heat-resistant steel aging grade based on metallographic images. Due to the fact that the background of metallographic images is complex and deep image features are difficult to extract, the dual attention module is introduced into the improved network to realize accurate extraction of image feature information. In order to meet the requirements of both high accuracy and lightweight, h-swish activation function is introduced into the improved network. Metallographic images of heat-resistant steel of different aging grades are used for model training and verification. Experimental results demonstrate the feasibility and accuracy of this method, which is based on metallographic images to realize automatic classification of aging grade of heat-resistant steel.

articleTitle: Quantum Neural Network Image Three-Classification Model Based on the Iris Dataset
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: Quantum neural networks, which combine quantum computing and machine learning, have become a topic of great interest due to the advancement of quantum computing. This paper introduces a pure quantum neural network model based on parameterized quantum circuits, applied to image classification using the Iris dataset. Experimental validation demonstrates superior classification accuracy in three-class tasks. Specifically, this paper innovatively uses IQP encoding to encode classical data into quantum states, and independently designs the Ansatz in the quantum neural network. Experimental results show that compared with the other three classical classification algorithms and four quantum neural network models, the pure quantum neural network model proposed in the study has the highest accuracy in image classification tasks. In addition, this article analyzes and evaluates the model’s expression characteristics and entanglement capabilities, providing a reference for further optimizing and expanding the quantum neural network model. Overall, this research provides new ideas and methods for the integration of quantum computing and machine learning, which has certain practical value and research significance.

articleTitle: Collaborative filtering recommendation for digital resource services integrating context and social networks
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: In the heterogeneous environment, in order to further improve the accuracy of digital resource service collaborative filtering recommendation based on user and alleviate the impact of cold start and data sparsity on recommendation quality, a digital resource service collaborative filtering recommendation method that integrates reader context and social network is proposed. Firstly, a comprehensive calculation method for reader nearest neighbor similarity that integrates rating similarity calculation, context similarity calculation, and neighbor trust calculation was designed. Secondly, a rating prediction and service recommendation method based on comprehensive calculation of reader nearest neighbor similarity was proposed. Finally, a new recommendation algorithm was designed based on the collaborative filtering recommendation framework. In addition, a trust calculation algorithm was designed based on the Dijkstra to calculate the trust of the reader's neighbors. Experiments on real datasets show that the proposed method improves the accuracy of collaborative filtering recommendation based on user to a certain extent, and alleviates the impact of cold start and data sparsity on recommendation quality to some extent

articleTitle: A Graph Attention Network Combining Community Detection and Natural Language Processing to Predict Metabolite-Disease Associations
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: In view of the limitation of existing research, which primarily relies on similarity as input features for the model without considering the extraction of features from the intrinsic information of metabolite or disease, and only focuses on the existing associations between metabolite and disease while neglecting their potential associations, this study proposes the GCDNLP model, a graph attention network that combines community detection and natural language processing to predict metabolite-disease associations. Firstly, the Mol2Vec algorithm is employed to extract the ontological features of metabolite from the perspective of their molecular structures, which are then combined with the metabolite similarity features. Secondly, the Doc2Vec+TF-IDF algorithm is introduced to compute the ontological features of disease. Finally, the prior probability matrix construction algorithm PPMCD based on community detection is proposed to uncover the unconfirmed potential associations between metabolite and disease within the network. The computed results, represented as prior probabilities, are then integrated with the graph attention network for further processing. Experimental results demonstrate the superiority of this model over existing algorithms in multiple evaluation metrics.

articleTitle: Optimizing EV Charging Station Placement in New South Wales: A Soft Actor-Critic Reinforcement Learning Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: In this work, the Soft Actor-Critic (SAC) reinforcement learning algorithm is employed to investigate the optimization of new electric vehicle (EV) charging station layouts in New South Wales. This work integrates traffic density data and existing charging station locations, aiming to minimize the distance between electric vehicles and charging stations. It will ease the growing pressure on demand for EV infrastructure. Tailored reward mechanisms are designed within the SAC framework to accommodate adaptive dimensionality, demonstrating strong compatibility with urban scenarios. The model’s performance offers convincing evidence of its efficacy in real-world settings. Integrating more granular data and more detailed reward mechanism design could enhance local decision-making processes, leading to more coherent overall infrastructure planning. This work contributes to advancing sustainable urban mobility by showcasing how advanced machine-learning techniques can be utilized in infrastructure planning.

articleTitle: Research on paint defect detection algorithm based on improved YOLOv5s
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: The process of detecting and processing images for paint defects generated during the automobile manufacturing production process is more complex. Existing paint defect target detection exists with a large number of parameters, low detection and recognition accuracy, and leakage problems. It is proposed to improve the paint defect target detection algorithm based on the YOLOv5s algorithm. The lightweight backbone MobileNetv2 is utilised to replace its backbone network, and the Conv convolution in MobileNetv2 is replaced with the full-dimensional dynamic convolution (ODConv) to improve the detection accuracy while reducing the computational effort. The FPN+PAN-based neck part introduces the inverted residual mobile module (iRMB), predicts the head structure of small and medium target layers, and convolves the original Convolution with iRMB-Conv. By using this method to improve the network feature extraction ability and reduce the number of parameters, we effectively increase the detection ability of medium- and small-sized targets. The experimental results demonstrate improvements over the original algorithm in terms of detection precision P, recall rate R, average precision mean, and defect-specific type detection precision mAP0.5. The improved model not only ensures a smaller model, but the algorithm also effectively improves detection precision.

articleTitle: SSP-GAN:Spectral Normalization Sphere-Guided 3D Point Cloud Generation
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
