abstract: The proposed SSP-GAN is designed to tackle stability and convergence issues encountered during the training of three-dimensional point cloud generative adversarial networks (GANs). We introduce spectral normalization to the SP-GAN architecture, constraining the noise generation process of the generator to produce shapes that are more uniform and adhere closely to real distributions. Additionally, spectral normalization is applied to the discriminator to effectively limit its learning capacity, preventing overfitting to training data. Furthermore, we implemented a training strategy utilizing a two time-scale update rule, adjusting the update frequencies for both the generator and discriminator. The generator updates at a slower pace compared to the discriminator, facilitating convergence of the 3D point cloud GAN to a local Nash equilibrium. Experimental results demonstrate that our approach outperforms SP-GAN across various evaluation metrics, exhibiting improved convergence and significantly reduced training times. The generated 3D shapes are richer and more detailed, showcasing the efficacy of SSP-GAN.

articleTitle: Image Fusion of Catenary Components Based on Laplacian Pyramid
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: Aiming at the problems such as the lack of information in traditional images, the loss of color and details in polarization images, and the loss of some surface details, a polarization image fusion technique based on the Laplacian pyramid of catenary components is proposed. Firstly, the acquired polarization image is aligned and denoised, and then the polarization image and light intensity image are obtained by Stokes' formula, and then the Laplacian pyramid transform is used to decompose it. In the third level, low-frequency component is fused by the fusion strategy combining the variance matching degree and the regional variance adaption. For the low-frequency components in the first and second levels, a weighted averaging strategy is employed for fusion; and the fusion of the high-frequency components are fused by the strategy of taking the pixel to the larger one. Finally, the fused image is subjected to adaptive histogram equalization to enhance the image. The results of the trial experiments show that the details of the image obtained by fusion of this method are more obvious, the fusion effect is better, and compared with other traditional image fusion algorithms, the objective evaluation indexes of this method are all higher than those of other methods, which provides a reference for the detection of the railroad system.

articleTitle: Construction of a two-layer model for vehicle path planning and its solution by hybrid optimisation algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: In order to solve the vehicle path planning problem, a two-layer model of vehicle path planning and traffic flow distribution is constructed. The upper layer model is a vehicle path planning model based on multiple distribution centres, which calculates the vehicle path with the minimum total distribution time. The lower model is the traffic flow allocation model based on the principle of system optimality. The results obtained by the upper layer model will change the travelling data in the lower layer model, and the calculated data of the lower layer model will also affect the roadway travelling time in the upper layer model, so that more realistic path planning distribution paths can be obtained through the interaction relationship between the upper and lower layer models. In order to improve the convergence and distribution of the multi-objective optimisation algorithm, a hybrid jumping spider algorithm and snake algorithm are proposed. The validation results with examples show that the results obtained from the two-layer model are more in line with the real travelling situation and achieve the balance between distance and time.

articleTitle: Research on Cloud Computing Microservice Resource Management Strategy Based on GraphGRU
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: In large-scale production clusters, accurately predicting the resource usage of workloads is crucial for understanding application characteristics and effectively managing cluster resources. However, traditional statistical-based forecasting methods face challenges when dealing with dynamic and complex predictions of cluster resource utilization. Modern applications are typically deployed in a distributed manner on clusters, rendering traditional single-node resource prediction methods inadequate in forecasting resource usage. To address this issue, we propose a novel deep learning model called GraphGRU. This model leverages Graph Attention Networks (GAT) to predict resource usage from a clustering perspective. We utilize the Dynamic Time Warping (DTW) algorithm to construct graph structures for multiple physical nodes in the cluster and employ a data compensation-like method to jointly train the model with horizontal and vertical data, thereby enhancing model performance. We validate our model on a microservices dataset captured from real-world large-scale production clusters. Compared to traditional deep learning methods, our model improves prediction accuracy by 48.27%. The innovation of this approach lies in integrating the advantages of graph neural networks and recurrent neural networks, and fully exploiting the relationships among multiple physical nodes in the cluster. Through this approach, we can more accurately predict resource usage in large-scale clusters, providing cluster operators with more effective resource management strategies.

articleTitle: UWB Dual Base Station Localization Based on Neural Network and LSTM
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: Indoor positioning technology has broad application prospects in fields such as smart IoT, indoor navigation, and smart homes. Ultra-wideband (UWB) technology, with its high accuracy, strong anti-interference capability, and ability to penetrate obstacles, has become an important means for indoor positioning. To address this, this paper proposes a model that integrates neural networks and Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) networks for indoor area localization tasks. Experimental results demonstrate that this model achieves high positioning accuracy in indoor environments with only a small number of base stations. Compared to traditional methods, the model significantly improves positioning accuracy. This work provides a novel and effective solution for indoor positioning, reducing positioning costs and improving the accuracy of coordinate-free positioning, thereby meeting the practical needs of indoor positioning.

articleTitle: An Audio Processing System Based on DRC and FFT Integration
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: This paper aims to develop an audio processing system that integrates Dynamic Range Control (DRC) and Fast Fourier Transform (FFT) technology, aiming to provide a clearer and more natural auditory experience for hearing-impaired individuals; By precisely adjusting the amplitude and frequency of audio signals, this system can adapt to individual hearing characteristics and diverse auditory environments. It combines two technologies to achieve two-dimensional audio adjustment. Compared with traditional hearing aids, this system demonstrates higher flexibility and adaptability. It can dynamically optimize audio signals based on real-time audio environments and user hearing test results, and is expected to improve communication skills and quality of life for hearing impaired individuals.

articleTitle: Research on Information Extraction Methods for Social Governance Event Description Texts
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: The information in the field of social governance has characteristics such as large scale, wide scope, and complex relationships. Entity relationship extraction technology can extract its core information and improve the processing efficiency of staff. This article proposes a pre trained language model remote supervised entity relationship extraction method for this field, aiming to more effectively extract key entities and relationships between entities in social governance events. The experimental results show that compared to other technologies, this method further improves its main performance for information extraction in the field of social governance, providing a more effective solution for information processing and extraction in this field.

articleTitle: Lightweight fuzzy testing method based on stake points of power control system
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: Cyber threats are extremely frequent, and fuzz testing is an effective method to discover vulnerabilities. Regarding the optimization of fuzz testing cost, firstly, the cost distribution of each module during the fuzz testing process was studied. Then, based on the problems of damaged coverage information and excessive additional overhead in existing lightweight fuzz testing methods, a lightweight fuzz testing method based on stubs is proposed, which can be flexibly implemented while retaining fine-grained coverage information. The cancellation and recovery of stub points effectively reduces the execution overhead of fuzz testing. Finally, this method accepts the protocol program of the power system, effectively reducing the execution overhead of fuzz testing.

articleTitle: SVT-AV1 Encoder based Efficiency Improvement of Screen Content Encoding
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: The AV1 encoder has a much slower encoding speed than H.264 and HEVC encoding due to its use of more complex algorithms and more computing resources. Although some algorithm optimizations have been carried out on the basis of the AV1 encoder to improve the encoding efficiency of the SVT-AV1 encoder, it is still a huge challenge to the level of large-scale application. To effectively solve the developed problem, this paper focuses on improving the encoding efficiency of screen content encoding in SVT-AV1 encoder. In this work, the encoding speed is improved by optimizing the palette table generation mode and intra block copy search prediction algorithm in SVT-AV1 encoder. The experimental results demonstrate that the proposed optimization method is effective and can greatly improve the encoding efficiency of the encoder while ensuring video quality. In addition, the optimization method proposed in this paper is not only applicable to screen content videos, but also to other videos.

articleTitle: Yunnan Tibetan Buddhist Mural Restoration Based on Entropy Reduction Strategy and Boundary Structure Factor
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: Aiming at the problems of repair redundancy and structure breakage in the current image inpainting algorithm based on sample block in the inpainting results of Tibetan Buddhist mural images in Yunnan, an improved algorithm based on the strategy of entropy reduction and boundary structure factor is proposed. Firstly, the selection rule of sample block is changed according to the entropy reduction strategy to improve the overall proportion of known information in the inpainting process. Then the boundary structure factor is introduced into the priority, and the repair order is adjusted according to the curvature information. The update rule of confidence value is defined by comprehensively considering the distance between the repaired pixel and the source region and the impact of the overall repair order. Experimental results show that the proposed algorithm can effectively improve the phenomenon of irrational filling and obtain high-quality restoration of mural images.

articleTitle: Sensitive Information Recognition for Content Distribution System based on Text Classification
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: Sensitive text information recognition aims at avoiding the leakage of sensitive information during the circulation of massive text data information, which has gradually become a research hotspot for scholars with the arrival of the digital era. In this study, we propose BERT-CLSTM-Attention, a text classification model based on the attention mechanism, and SIR, a sensitive text recognition algorithm; by comparing experiments with other classical models, the results show that the SIR algorithm for the content distribution system has a significant enhancement effect on the task of sensitive text information recognition. Finally, we outline the challenges that lie ahead for future research in the context of the entire paper.

articleTitle: RALT—A film review sentiment classification model
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: With the development of the internet and film industry, filmgoers have published a large amount of review texts in many areas such as film analysis, film sharing, and social media. The interpretation of review texts is diverse and strongly environmentally dependent, which adds more difficulty to the task of text classification. How to quickly and accurately judge the sentiment tendency of review texts and classify them accurately, and improve the application value of review text data has become one of the popular research directions in natural language processing (NLP). This article proposes a film review sentiment analysis model RALT, which combines a text convolutional neural network (TextCNN) with a self-attention mechanism and a fused long short-term memory (LSTM). The model uses the RoBERTa Employing a pre-trained model to produce dynamic textual word embeddings addresses the intricacies associated with polysemy. Sentiment classification experiments were conducted on the IMDB dataset. The experiments were conducted by comparing BERT and RoBERTa with TextCNN, RNN, LSTM, BI-LSTM and other models, and it was found that the proposed model achieved the best accuracy and F1-score in the classification task.The experiment showed that the model is suitable for the field of film review sentiment classification.

articleTitle: Hierarchical partition clustering method based on DBSCAN to solve the depth value of Contaminated runway
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: To solve the error caused by using laser measurement technology to continuously sample the movement of pollutants covering the road surface and classify the high points to measure the depth of the pollutants on the road surface, a density-based spatial clustering based on segmented clustering is proposed ( DBSCAN) algorithm for detection and calibration of pavement pollutant depth measurement data.First, according to the segmentation detection distance constraint and category parameters, the ε neighborhood radius and the MinPts minimum number of neighborhood points are selected to cluster and group the pollutant depth data set. Then the similar depth clusters within the segmentation interval are merged. Then the DBSCAN1D algorithm is used to Calculate the correlation of depth data in the clustered data set, and finally select the midpoint as the segmented depth measurement value.Through an example verification on the depth movement sampling data of pollutants on an airport pavement, the results show that the method proposed in this paper can effectively avoid the impact of collecting fluctuating noise data and measurement error data while ensuring that the segmented detection distance constraints are met, and ensure the runway surface The accuracy of the pollutant depth measurement data and the detection effect are better than the K-means method. This method can provide airports with more accurate runway surface condition information, providing strong support for ensuring flight safety.

articleTitle: An Improved Method for Pneumonia Image Classification Based on CoAtNet
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: The most effective way to identify pneumonia is through the use of Chest X-Ray (CXR), but accurately interpreting these images can pose a formidable challenge for even seasoned professionals. This difficulty can potentially result in patients receiving incorrect treatment. To address this issue, a novel neural network called CoAtNet is adopted in this study to aid doctors in achieving more precise pneumonia diagnoses. This network structure combines the Convolutional Neural Networks and Vision Transformer. It better generalization obtained from convolution blocks and higher model capacity by applying Transformer mechanism. Totally, 5216 photos from Kaggle are used as training set and 624 photos are used as test set. At the beginning of each epoch, 30% photos in training set are chosen to be inputted into validation set randomly. By applying data augmentation to the training set, the model is less likely to be overfitting and has better generalization. When compiling the model, Adam is chosen to be the optimizer and Categorical Cross Entropy is adopted to be the loss function. After 10 epochs’ training, both the validation set and training set converge sufficiently. After running the model on the test set, the model shows great performance with a high accuracy of 86.70%, high precision of 83.44% and 90.22% F1-Score.

articleTitle: Malware Detection Techniques and Research Based on Image Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: With the development of Internet, the speed of malware iteration is accelerating. To cope with the new scale and rapid variation, further optimize the model structure of malware detection, and improve the detection efficiency and accuracy, we establish a malware detection model based on image analysis. The steps of the model are as follows: (1) Image the malware into gray-scale image through B2M algorithm, and organize the malware gray-scale map dataset; (2) Establish the Keras-based CNN model and fill the model for training and testing; (3) Save the model parameters to establish malware Detection model. We introduce the image analysis technology and convolutional neural network correlation theory, as well as the construction steps of the detection model, and then evaluates and analyzes the detection results, compared with traditional image vector-based PCA methods and LDA methods, singular value decomposition methods for image feature extraction, and other algorithms. The model has efficient structure, which realizes lightweight with low time and spatial complexity, improves the efficiency of detection while maintaining high detection accuracy, and also has good detection capability for variant malware. Currently, it can better cope with the new characteristics of large-scale and rapid transformation of malware, which has a meaningful future for development.

articleTitle: Research on fault diagnosis of KPCA-WOA-BP transformer
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: In order to quickly identify transformer faults and process them, a transformer fault diagnosis model based on Kernel PCA (KPCA) and Whale Optimization Algorithm (WOA) optimized BP neural network is provided. Firstly, the traditional data of various miscellaneous gases used to solve the nonlinear fault of transformer are reduced by kernel principal component analysis (KPCA). According to the uncertainty of a single BP (Back Backpropagation) neural network, which is easy to fall into local optimization and has poor accuracy, the input data is normalized first, and then whale algorithm is used to solve its various weights and thresholds for each work, reducing the workload, The overall mean square error of the training set and the test set is used as the fitness function to optimize the parameters. The performance comparison with Grey Wolf Optimizer (GWO)and Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO) proves its superiority. KPCA-WOA-BP transformer fault diagnosis model is built. The accuracy is 90%, Compared with KPCA-GWO-BP model, KPCA-PSO-BP model and KPCA-BP model, it is improved by 8%, 12% and 22% respectively.

articleTitle: Enhanced iteration closest point is based on stochastic differential evolution algorithm and random sampling
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: To address the issue of low accuracy in 3D point cloud registration, we present a novel iterative closest point (ICP) algorithm for point registration using the stochastic differential evolution algorithm and random sampling (SDE_ICP). Given ICP's sensitivity to the initial transformation matrix, our approach divides the algorithm into two stages: coarse registration and fine registration. In the coarse registration phase, we introduce a random sampling algorithm to the original point cloud, expediting the coarse registration process. Subsequently, we propose a stochastic differential evolution (SDE) algorithm with random opposition-based learning population initialization, random centroid mutation, and a boundary control strategy. The search individual comprises translation and rotation transformation parameters, offering a robust relative initial position for subsequent ICP fine registration. Finally, we conduct simulations and analyses using Bimba, Angle, and Bunny datasets from FGR to evaluate SDE_ICP. We compare its performance with ICP, TrICP, DE_ICP, and SaDE_ICP. The results indicate that the proposed method exhibits superior accuracy.

articleTitle: Transformer Encoder-Decoder with depth-wise separable convolution for Low-Dose CT Denoising
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: Low-dose computed tomography (LDCT) images frequently suffer from noise and artifacts due to diminished radiation doses, challenging the diagnostic integrity of the images. We introduce an innovative approach, the Transformer Encoder-Decoder with Depth-wise Separable Convolution (ECformer), which incorporates depth-wise separable convolution into the Transformer architecture. This synergistic fusion of convolutional neural network (CNN) and Transformer capabilities notably enhances spatial information capture while concurrently mitigating computational demands. Specifically, depth-wise separable convolution supplants traditional linear projection within the Transformer, facilitating efficient learning of local contextual dynamics. Further, the adoption of an encoder-decoder architecture bolsters the hierarchical feature representation, with shortcut connections ensuring the preservation of detail. Empirical evaluations on the AAPM-Mayo Clinic Low-Dose CT Grand Challenge Dataset confirm that ECformer outperforms existing denoising methods.

articleTitle: I-Topic: An Image-text Topic Modeling Method Based on Community Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: Multimodal content, including images, audio, and videos, has occupied a rising proportion of online information. Rich semantics and emotions are expressed through the interplay between different data modes. The existing multimodal topic models mainly focus on the semantic alignment between different data modes, while we argue that other data modes should play an equally important role with text. Thus, we proposed an image-text topic modeling method (I-Topic) to preliminarily explore the interplay between different data modes. Multi-modal pre-trained models and community detection are integrated into I-Topic. A new image-text dataset composed of visual memes is constructed for evaluation. Experimental results on three datasets suggested the effectiveness of I-Topic. Manual observation proved that visual elements could help improve the diversity of topics.

articleTitle: Multi-strategy improved GTO algorithm for numerical optimization experiments
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: The GTO algorithm has the disadvantages of easily falling into local optimum and low convergence. To solve these problems, a multi-strategy improved GTO algorithm is proposed in this paper. First, the initial population in the original algorithm is improved by using a quasi-opposite learning strategy based on Sinusoidal mapping to enrich the diversity of the population. Second, in order to reduce the possibility of its falling into local optimum, the paper proposes an adaptive exploration strategy based on stochastic factor control. Finally, the paper proposes a levy flight development method based on adaptive parameters, which helps to obtain better solutions. Tested by 12 test functions in the CEC2022 test set, the experimental results show that the accuracy of the proposed algorithm is greatly improved in dealing with numerical optimization problems.

articleTitle: Subdivision Algorithm of A Type αβ-Bézier Curve
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: Splines with shape parameters have stronger expression ability than the traditional splines. In this paper, a αβ-Bézier curve with shape parameters are studied. A necessary condition for obtaining subdivision algorithms based on De Casteljau algorithm for general parameter curves is given. Under this condition, it was verified that the αβ-Bézier curve cannot calculate the control points of the subdivided sub-curves through De Casteljau algorithm. The αβ-Bézier curve subdivision algorithm was provided by the mutual transformation relationship between the αβ-Bézier curve and the classical Bézier curve. The two sub-curves are defined by the two sets of control points obtained through the subdivision algorithm and αβ-Bézier basis functions. The algorithm is simple, intuitive, and easy to operate. Calculation examples also demonstrate the feasibility and effectiveness of the algorithm.

articleTitle: Realization of external damage and flood monitoring and early warning platform for transmission and distribution lines
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: This paper develops a satellite-ground collaborative external damage and flood monitoring and early warning module for the tasks of external damage and flood monitoring of power transmission and distribution lines. It analyzes and designs the functional requirements of the module for different emergency monitoring tasks, builds the basic framework of the module, and outlines a blueprint for the development of the system. improve the user experience and facilitate the implementation of the system.

articleTitle: Application of heuristic function optimization strategy of A* algorithm in path planning of mobile robot
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: Research the application of A* algorithm in path planning. Examine several different optimization strategies for the A* algorithm heuristic function. These strategies aim to improve the search efficiency and path quality of the algorithm. To verify the effectiveness of each strategy, simulations were conducted in two raster map environments with different levels of complexity. The results show that the optimization strategy of the heuristic function can improve the algorithm performance to a certain extent, and the effects of different strategies are related to the complexity of the environment.

articleTitle: Temperature drift compensation of silicon micro-resonant accelerometers based on BP neural network
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: The functionality of MEMS accelerometers is significantly influenced by fluctuations in ambient temperature. To resolve this issue, it is necessary to employ effective temperature compensation techniques. This article introduces an innovative method for compensating accelerometer temperature effects using BP neural networks. Initially, the article examines the temperature deviation mechanism of resonant accelerometers. Then, a conventional polynomial fitting method is used to obtain the zero deviation and scale factor of the accelerometer versus temperature, and the zero deviation and scale factor versus input acceleration. Subsequently, a BP neural network was employed to establish a relationship between the input acceleration and the two resonant frequencies, with temperature compensation performed using the two methods above. A comparison of the compensation results reveals that the zero-bias temperature sensitivities of uncompensated, polynomial, and BP neural network compensation are -45.44ug/°C, 13.0347ug/°C, and 1.542ug/°C, respectively. The scale factor temperature sensitivities are 32.04 ppm/°C, -8.13 ppm/°C, and 0.97 ppm/°C, respectively. The results show that the error correction ability of BP neural networks is improved by about ten times compared to polynomial fitting methods.

articleTitle: EsccNet: A Hybrid CNN and Transformers Model for the Classification of Whole Slide Images of Esophageal Squamous Cell Carcinoma
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: This study presents a novel approach in the application of deep learning for the classification of esophageal squamous cell carcinoma (Escc) using whole-slide images (WSIs). Our methodology uniquely combines Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) with Transformer, leveraging the strengths of both architectures to enhance the accuracy and efficiency of cancer detection and classification in histopathological images. In this research, we first preprocess a substantial dataset of WSI samples, annotated by expert pathologists, to train and validate our model. The CNN component effectively extracts detailed local features from the high-resolution images, while the Transformer, known for its capability in handling sequential data, adeptly manages the global context, addressing the challenges posed by the complex and heterogeneous nature of WSIs. The accuracy, F1 score, recall, and precision of our proposed model on the dataset provided by Fujian Cancer Hospital are 94.71%, 94.32%, 94.68%, and 94.08%, respectively, which are significantly better than other models. This study not only assists pathologists in analyzing esophageal squamous carcinoma WSIs but also paves the way for further research into the combined application of CNN and Transformer in the diagnosis of other types of cancer.

articleTitle: Research on GRU-Based Load Prediction Method for Vehicular Network Servers in a Multi-Task Offloading Environment
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: In a multi-task offloading environment, to improve the efficiency of resource allocation and utilization in vehicular network servers, this paper proposes a load prediction method based on GRU-RNN. Initially, a GRU-RNN neural network is selected to build the load prediction model, using the Adam algorithm as the optimizer. Subsequently, the Alibaba Cluster-trace-v2018 dataset is utilized, with data normalization and preprocessing, followed by model hyperparameter acquisition through grid search and cross-validation methods. Finally, simulation results show that the trained model can accurately predict the vehicular network server load, demonstrating high accuracy, stability, and reliability.

articleTitle: MDSGA: A Limited Resources Deployment Strategy of Microservice-based Application based on Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: In recent years, the deployment strategy of microservice instances has become one of the important issues concerned by microservice applications. Most solutions assume that resources are sufficient to satisfy all current user requests, and the total response time of user requests is a constant. When user requests cannot be executed concurrently due to limited resources, the time to complete user requests is a variable and needs to be considered in the deployment strategy. This paper proposes a limited resources microservice deployment strategy based on improved genetic algorithm. By improving the individual coding method, each individual has a microservice deployment substring and a user request scheduling substring, so that the strategy can calculate the optimal deployment strategy based on the deployment distribution status and scheduling relationship. This paper also proposes a calculation method for user request response time considering the microservice chain under limited resources, and calculates the user request response time considering the blocking state time of microservices. Experimental results show that the strategy can effectively calculate the microservice deployment scheme with low total response time of user requests, low load balancing rate and high resource utilization rate under the condition of limited resources.

articleTitle: Enhancing Parallelization with OpenMP through Multi-Modal Transformer Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: The popularity of multicore processors and the rise of High Performance Computing as a Service (HPCaaS) have made parallel programming essential to fully utilize the performance of multicore systems. OpenMP, a widely adopted shared-memory parallel programming model, is favored for its ease of use. However, it is still challenging to assist and accelerate automation of its parallelization. Although existing automation tools such as Cetus and DiscoPoP to simplify the parallelization, there are still limitations when dealing with complex data dependencies and control flows. Inspired by the success of deep learning in the field of Natural Language Processing (NLP), this study adopts a Transformer-based model to tackle the problems of automatic parallelization of OpenMP instructions. We propose a novel Transformer-based multimodal model, ParaMP, to improve the accuracy of OpenMP instruction classification. The ParaMP model not only takes into account the sequential features of the code text, but also incorporates the code structural features and enriches the input features of the model by representing the Abstract Syntax Trees (ASTs) corresponding to the codes in the form of binary trees. In addition, we built a BTCode dataset, which contains a large number of C/C++ code snippets and their corresponding simplified AST representations, to provide a basis for model training. Experimental evaluation shows that our model outperforms other existing automated tools and models in key performance metrics such as F1 score and recall. This study shows a significant improvement on the accuracy of OpenMP instruction classification by combining sequential and structural features of code text, which will provide a valuable insight into deep learning techniques to programming tasks.

articleTitle: An Online Transfer Learning Model for Intrusion Detection using FT-Transformer and KSWIN-Driven Concept Drift Detection Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: Deep learning has been successful in intrusion detection, but new attack methods cause data distribution changes, known as concept drift. To address this, we propose an online transfer learning method. It includes a concept drift detection mechanism to identify traffic pattern changes and fine-tune deep learning models accordingly. Experimental results show an average accuracy of 99.46% on the CIC-IDS dataset and 96.79% on the NetFlow V2 dataset.

articleTitle: Top-k Self-Attention in Transformer for Video Inpainting
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: Video inpainting restores missing content using global dependencies and relevant non-local frame portions. Recent Transformer-based techniques utilize self-attention mechanisms to establish connections between global patch embeddings. However, due to the scarcity of relevant regions, existing methods end up allocating partial attention weights to a significant number of irrelevant areas. This situation results in a dispersion of dependencies, which negatively impacts modeling accuracy. To address this issue, we introduce a top-k self-attention mechanism specifically designed for Transformer-based video inpainting, which filters out the weights of less relevant regions. This proposed mechanism computes a top-k weight threshold for each missing patch and compels the Transformer to focus on the k most pertinent patch embeddings. As a result, the accuracy of dependency modeling is enhanced, leading to more effective content aggregation for filling in the missing regions. The top-k mechanism is easily integrated into any Transformer-based model, and experiments conducted on the YouTube-VOS and DAVIS datasets show that it significantly improves the model's performance while maintaining high efficiency.

articleTitle: Adaptive Discrete-Time Quantized Control for Multi-machine Power System with SVC
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: In this paper, a discrete-time adaptive dynamic surface quantization control method has been proposed for a class of multi-machine power systems with Static Var Compensator (SVC). The strategy combines RBF neural network and discrete low-pass filter to solve the differential explosion problem in backstepping and simplify the control law. Chatter is also reduced by a modified hysteresis quantizer, and digital control is achieved. Ultimate uniformly bounded properties of closed-loop systems are proved by designing Lyapunov functions and the simulation results confirm the effectiveness of the method.

articleTitle: Defect Recognition of Traction Wire Rope Based on Improved EfficientNet Network
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: This paper proposes an improved EfficientNet network-based method for recognizing defects in traction wire ropes, aiming to address the current issues of low efficiency and poor robustness in defect recognition. Based on the EfficientNet network, we introduced the ECA module instead of the original SE module and improved the loss function. The experimental results demonstrate that the improved EfficientNet network achieves a classification accuracy of 99.3% for defect recognition of traction wire rope, which is 1.1% higher than that of the original network. This improvement better meets the engineering application of defect recognition of traction wire rope.

articleTitle: Deployment problem of Wireless Sensor Networks based on Adaptive Particle Swarm Optimization
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: In response to the shortcomings of particle swarm optimization (PSO) such as insufficient global search, susceptibility to local optima, and slow convergence speed, this paper proposes an improved adaptive PSO (APSO). Firstly, a superior point set is employed for particle population initialization, achieving a more uniform and extensive particle distribution. Secondly, during the particle velocity update phase, an adaptive Levy flight acceleration coefficient is introduced along with adjustments to the social learning factor, emphasizing global search. Finally, in the particle position update phase, an adaptive scaling factor is introduced to intelligently adjust particle position weights, aiding in obtaining superior solutions. The proposed APSO is applied to the wireless sensor network deployment problem, and experimental results demonstrate its outstanding performance in solving optimization problems.

articleTitle: Weed Semantic Segmentation Network Combining Hybrid Attention Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: Weed removal plays a crucial role in agricultural production. As the foundation for future intelligent weeding, precise weeding relies heavily on image recognition and segmentation. This paper proposes an enhanced hybrid attention mechanism, cbam, to be integrated into a semantic segmentation model using Unet as the model framework and resnet50 as the backbone extraction network. The aim is to address the challenges of low recognition rate and poor segmentation effect of maize seedling and weed images in complex environments. The results demonstrate that this attention mechanism significantly enhances the performance of the network model. Through adjusting the embedding position, the average intersection ratio of image segmentation reaches 90.01%, with an average pixel accuracy of 98.25%. These findings indicate that the segmentation model excels in actual segmentation tasks, meeting the requirements for seedling and grass recognition segmentation tasks effectively.

articleTitle: A change point method for monitoring generalized linear profiles in Phase I
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: In Phase I monitoring problems for generalized linear models, we assume that Poisson functional data with fixed samples collected over time follows a generalized linear model. Subsequently, we propose the likelihood ratio function of the change-point method, combined with constructing Exponentially Weighted Moving Average (EWMA) statistic, to monitor generalized linear models where parameters are undisclosed but can be approximated using historical data. Through numerous numerical simulations, we have derived the control limits and achieved the desired Average Run Length (ARL).

articleTitle: Whispering Packets: Hiding Messages in VoIP Traffic
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: This paper takes the popular applications WeChat and Enterprise WeChat as examples and investigates the embedding of information in VoIP traffic for data transmission. Exploring the alterations in VoIP traffic characteristics under different vocal environments, this study proposes a covert communication method that transforms the traffic features from silent vocal states to noisy by modifying the length distribution of VoIP traffic. Experimental results demonstrate that this approach achieves channel bandwidths of up to 35kbps and 28kbps in the silent vocal environments of WeChat and Enterprise WeChat, respectively.

articleTitle: Research on spinal orthopedic locator image segmentation algorithm in X-ray images
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: In the process of orthopedic 2D/3D medical image registration, a spinal orthopedic locator is needed to assist registration. There is a spinal orthopedic locator image in the orthopedic X-ray image that hinders registration. It is necessary to segment and remove the spinal orthopedic locator image in the X-ray image to improve registration. Accuracy. In response to the above problems, this paper proposes the SR-UNet deep learning algorithm model for segmentation of spinal orthopedic locator images in orthopedic X-ray images. Based on the advantages of U-shaped network in medical image segmentation, SR-UNet network combines U-shaped network, The characteristics of residual network and asymmetric network can accurately segment the spinal orthopedic locator image. The SR-UNet network model is trained through the self-built training set and verification set, and the performance of the simulation with accurate segmentation is evaluated through the Dice Similarity Coefficient (DSC) index. The SR-UNet deep learning algorithm model ensures high-precision segmentation effects and can accurately segment spinal orthopedic locator images in orthopedic X-ray images. In the case of the same image data set, the DSC index exceeds other model networks.

articleTitle: Potato identification and spacing prediction based on improved YOLOv5
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: Potato is the fourth largest grain crop in China, which is of great significance for food security, but there is still a big gap between the mechanization level of the potato industry in China and that of foreign countries. Therefore, enhancing the mechanization level in the production process is very important to further improve the production efficiency and promote the modernization of agriculture. In this paper, we propose a potato identification and distance detection method using the improved YOLOv5 target detection algorithm, which is optimized on the basis of the original YOLOv5 structure, to identify and label the spacing of potatoes by acquiring photographs of potatoes in the field, so as to achieve the purpose of controlling the spacing of potato planting, and avoiding insufficient supply of nutrients or waste of space due to the spacing of plants that are too small or too large. Through data enhancement of the obtained pictures and then training of the model, the average accuracy mean MAP_0.5 and MAP_0.5-0.95 of the recognition finally reached 99.5% and 95.9%, respectively, and the distance error of the recognition results was examined to be controlled within 1cm.

articleTitle: The Study of Ceramic Product Recommendation System based on Knowledge Graph
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: With the rapid rise of mobile internet, the network has brought convenience to all aspects of people's lives, but it has also brought about the problem of 'information overload'. The combination of personalized recommendation systems and mobile e-commerce has to some extent alleviated the drawbacks of 'information overload'. This article is based on the ceramic knowledge graph for the ceramic product recommendation system, providing a demonstration case for vertical e-commerce enterprises.

articleTitle: Adaptive Diagnosis of DC Motors using PSO-SVM Classifier combined with VMD-SVD Technique
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: Feature extraction and classifiers play a central role in the traditional fault diagnosis methods for DC motors. In this paper, an innovative approach to mechanical fault diagnosis which is adaptive and intelligent, was proposed to extract more prominent signal features and achieve higher recognition accuracy. First, The raw signals underwent variational mode decomposition (VMD) to decompose them into several intrinsic mode functions (IMFs). Moreover, a new transient frequency means method was proposed to achieve the optimal value in a fast and accurate manner. Subsequently, singular value decomposition (SVD) was applied to further feature extraction. The particle swarm optimization (PSO) algorithm has been utilized to successfully establish the optimal support vector machine (SVM) classifier. According to the experimental results, it has been demonstrated that the proposed method; which has better adaptability and intelligence; can reach a 96.3% recognition rate on unknown samples.

articleTitle: Intelligent Recognition and Classification of IoT Devices via Information Physics-Based Multi-Source Data Association
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: With the development of information and intelligence in the power system, the massive integration of heterogeneous IoT devices poses new challenges in system administration and security. To address the classification and recognition challenges of IoT devices in power system, this paper proposes an intelligent approach that integrates multiple data sources with logical modeling. This method models the communication data of IoT devices as state transition graphs, augments them with statistical information to obtain attributed graphs, and utilizes graph kernel methods to measure the similarity between graphs, thereby achieving the classification and identification of IoT terminal devices. To reduce computational costs, local sensitive hashing (LSH) technology is introduced to maintain the attribute information of the original data. The proposed method aims to enhance the accuracy of IoT device identification and the efficiency of classification in the power system, providing robust support for system management and security maintenance.

articleTitle: Mining Transformer Fault Diagnosis Based on INGO Optimized LSSVM
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: In order to improve the diagnostic accuracy of mining transformers, an improved Northern Eagle Algorithm (INGO) optimized least squares support vector machine (LSSVM) fault diagnosis model for mining transformers was proposed. Firstly, KPCA is used to reduce the dimension of the obtained transformer fault data to reduce the impact of invalid features; Then, using the strategy of Logistic chaotic mapping, Cauchy mutation, and random difference perturbation, the traditional Northern Hawk algorithm is improved to improve its optimization ability. Compared with NGO and particle swarm optimization, it is proved that its convergence speed and solution accuracy have been improved; Finally, INGO is used to optimize the relevant hyperparameters in the solution set to improve the classification accuracy of LSSVM. The fault data processed by KPCA is input into the INGO-LSSVM diagnostic model for fault diagnosis simulation research. The simulation results show that the accuracy of the INGO-LSSVM model reaches 93.26%, which is 7.4% and 10.54% higher than the NGO-LSSVM and PSO-LSSVM models, demonstrating that the method in this paper can effectively improve the transformer diagnosis performance.

articleTitle: An improved ALNS algorithm for the Team Orienteering Problem with Time Windows
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: The Team Orienteering Problem with Time Windows (TOPTW) is a typical variant of the Orienteering Problem (OP) that each node can only provide one time service in a predefined time window, its objective is to maximize the total score of visiting nodes with a given number of paths. In this study we propose an improved ALNS(adaptive large neighborhood search) algorithm to solve the TOPTW problem, which clusters nodes according to their features to construct the initial solution, and design knowledge-based removal and repair operators to optimize solutions. To fully evaluate the proposed algorithm, some typical benchmark datasets are taken as the test instance suite and several state-of-the-art algorithms are chosen to compare with the proposed algorithm. Experimental results show our algorithm has satisfactory accuracy and far better performance.

articleTitle: Experiment system design of visual servo motion control for industrial robot
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: In this paper, an experiment system of visual servo robot motion control is designed, which includes an industrial robot, vision system and workbench. Specifically, the hardware design and software design of the experimental system are carried out, and the prototype platform of the experimental system is built. Based on the designed experimental system the surface profile image of the workpiece can be obtained and achieve the motion trajectory planning for the robot according to the feature points. During the movement of the robot, the vision camera can observe and feedback the end trajectory points of the robot in real time. The trajectory control experiment is tested and analyzed and the effectiveness of the visual servo motion control system is verified. The experiment system designed in this paper can be used for robot kinematics, trajectory planning and visual inspection, etc., which is significant for the talent training in scientific research and education teaching especially in the field of intelligent manufacturing.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Speech Recognition Examination System for Radar Intelligence Simulation Training
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: In order to solve the problems of poor speech recognition performance, low accuracy, difficulty in manual grade evaluation, and long training time in current radar intelligence simulation training software, this article designs a speech recognition examination system for radar intelligence simulation training based on the radar intelligence simulation training process; The system includes a system login module, a radar training module, a speech recognition module, and an automatic scoring module; The overall development is carried out using Python, with the system login module and radar training module mainly using the PyQt library. The speech recognition module mainly relies on the tensorflow library, and the automatic scoring module is implemented based on the math library. We have focused on improving the design of the speech recognition module by introducing the Feed Forward Deep Neural Network (FFDNN) into the acoustic model modeling, which improves the accuracy of speech recognition. We have also implemented the system's automatic scoring using the left and right sliding window algorithm; Through practical verification, the system has been proven to have accurate speech recognition, high accuracy, and accurate evaluation, which can meet the needs of radar intelligence training and improve the effectiveness of radar intelligence training under the aircraft.

articleTitle: Long Short Term Spatio-temporal Neural Network for Traffic Speed Forecasting
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: Traffic prediction is an important component of Intelligent Transportation System (ITS), and accurately predicting dynamic traffic conditions is a challenge to be solved. Capturing the locality and globality of spatiotemporal correlations plays a significant role in prediction, and existing methods cannot completely capture them. This paper proposes a Long Short Term Spatio-temporal Neural Network (LS2TNN) model for traffic speed prediction. The spatial gated graph convolutional attention module and time convolutional attention module in the model are used to capture long-term and short-term spatiotemporal correlations. Static graphs cannot effectively describe dynamic traffic flow. This paper uses predefined edge dynamic edge weights graphs and dynamic edge dynamic edge weights graphs for Graph Convolution Network (GCN), in order to better describe the dynamic traffic situation in real scenes. Experiments conducted on two real datasets showed that LS2TNN achieved advanced performance compared to the baselines.

articleTitle: Simulation study on intelligent analysis of turbidity in water distribution network based on BP and RBF neural network
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: The safety of water quality in water distribution networks is crucial to the health of people's drinking water. Predicting water quality changes in the network can effectively prevent the deterioration of water quality. This paper carries out an in-depth study on the characteristics and evolution of turbidity in pipeline network water. Summarized the change rule of drinking water turbidity index in the pipeline network. Accordingly, the three factors that have a greater impact on the change of turbidity in pipeline network water are screened out, i.e. flow rate, water age and total iron content. On the basis of continuous monitoring of the main factors, MATLAB was used to construct BP (Back propagation) and RBF (Radial basis function) neural network models to simulate and analyze the turbidity of pipe network water. The results show that the simulated values are in good agreement with the measured values, in which the RBF neural network has stronger nonlinear approximation ability and higher prediction accuracy.

articleTitle: Predicting multifunctional peptides based on feature fusion and EBiLSTM
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: In this study, we introduce a novel multifunctional peptide prediction framework that considers both sequence features and physicochemical properties of multifunctional peptides. Our approach incorporates traditional sequence feature extraction techniques as well as features describing the physicochemical properties of peptides, using feature fusion for a more comprehensive representation of peptide sequences. The utilization of these fused features is maximized through an advanced deep learning model comprising Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN), Enhanced Bidirectional Long Short-Term Memory networks (EBiLSTM), and multiple fully connected layers. The experimental results demonstrate the best performance with our feature fusion-based method, achieving key metrics of Accuracy and Absolute True at 0.607 and 0.533, respectively. By integrating diverse feature sets and deep learning models, our model outperforms others, offering valuable insights for peptide research and applications.

articleTitle: Change detection network for high-resolution remote sensing images based on hybrid backbone and attention fusion
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: The application of deep learning in change detection (CD) for remote sensing has greatly strengthened CD networks. Although convolutional neural networks (CNN) can capture local features well, they are inefficient at extracting global features, reducing the detection accuracy. To address this limitation, we introduced a transformer to solve the constrained receptive field issue. We proposed a Bi-SCNet backbone network that integrates convolution and transformer interactions to mine both local and global features simultaneously. Building on this, we introduced an Attention Fusion Module (AFM) that enhances feature extraction in both spatial and channel dimensions through AFM, focusing more on edge areas and small targets. Finally, the bitemporal features obtained are fed into the Transformer module to acquire difference information, resulting in a difference feature map. Extensive experiments conducted on the LEVIR-CD and WHU- CD datasets have proven that our algorithm is more competitive.

articleTitle: A Variable Neighborhood Search Algorithm for Drone-Truck Joint Distribution Problem
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: Delivery with drones combines the advantages of short delivery time, low cost and reduced road congestion. The joint delivery of trucks and drones to serve the customers in a community is the breakthrough to solve the problem of the last-mile delivery. We propose an arc-based mixed integer programming model with the aim of the lowest total distribution cost. We verify the effectiveness of Variable Neighborhood Search(VNS) algorithm in solving the model.

articleTitle: Research on path planning of continuous control UAV based on improved PSO algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: The introduction of intelligent search algorithms provides an excellent solution to the global and local path planning problems of UAVs. The most classic and representative is Particle Swarm Optimization ( PSO ). However, when applying PSO algorithm to UAV path planning, it is easy to be constrained by factors such as environmental changes and fail to achieve the expected results. In order to solve the communication delay and communication reliability problems in wireless communication, a path planning study under successive control of UAVs is proposed. In this study, the defects of PSO algorithm and the problems in UAV path planning are improved. The improved algorithm introduces the adaptive weight into the update mechanism, and combines the Levy flight strategy to improve the global search strategy to reduce the impact of environmental changes on the algorithm update, so as to ensure the optimal solution. It can be seen from the simulation results that the improved PSO algorithm has achieved significant improvement in data update accuracy, local and overall search capabilities. Compared with genetic algorithm, grey wolf optimization algorithm and PSO algorithm, the improved PSO algorithm has obvious advantages such as fast planning speed and short planning path.

articleTitle: A VR-Based Neuron Tracing Approach for Enhanced Efficiency
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: We introduce an innovative Virtual Reality (VR)-based methodology for the intricate process of neuron tracing, specifically designed to significantly enhance both the efficiency and accuracy of the neuronal reconstruction endeavors. By harnessing the immersive and interactive capabilities of VR technology, coupled with cutting-edge rendering techniques, this proposed approach adeptly tackles the longstanding challenges associated with occlusion and the complex mapping of spatial relationships that are critical in neuron tracing exercises. Comparative studies affirm the distinct advantage of this VR-based method over traditional desktop tools, particularly in terms of improved tracing efficiency and the depth of spatial comprehension it facilitates. This advancement is facilitated by the use of advanced algorithms like the A-star for pathfinding and the fast marching method for optimizing the tracing process. The research is backed by extensive experiments and user studies, indicating a promising direction for the application of VR technology in neuroanatomy and broader scientific research.

articleTitle: Tennis Match Situation Analysis and Prediction Method Based on Hybrid LightGBM Modeling
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: Accurately assessing an athlete's tactical performance is a key element for success in highly technical and competitive sports environments, but traditional analytical approaches are unable to comprehensively analyze the data and still have some limitations. This study proposes and implements a situation analysis and prediction method based on a hybrid LightGBM model and a large amount of game data. Through the combination of linear regression method, Pearson's coefficient, and multilayer perceptron, the LightGBM model has the best overall performance after comparing multiple methods, thus reflecting the model's high accuracy and goodness of fit, which can provide accurate situation analysis and tactical guidance for the game.

articleTitle: Research on China's Carbon Emission Peak and Trend Based on Support Vector Machines and Improved BP Neural Network Models
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: This paper focuses on the prediction and analysis of China's carbon emission peaks and trends through intelligent algorithms, in order to provide a scientific and realistic basis for the policy formulation of economic development and environmental protection. Firstly, a particle swarm algorithm optimised support vector machine prediction model (PSO-SVM) is designed and constructed to improve the computational speed and accuracy of prediction through the iteration of particle swarm algorithm, so as to predict the trend of carbon emission in China. Secondly, the improved neural network model using genetic algorithm (GA) and principal component analysis (PCA) was constructed, and the average error was trained to less than 5% after iterative training, so as to predict the carbon emissions. Finally, the prediction results of the two intelligent algorithms are compared. The results show that China's carbon peaks around 2035, after which China's carbon emissions will show a decreasing trend year by year.

articleTitle: Research on the Construction of Knowledge Platform for Pumped Storage Power Station
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: The purpose of introducing the knowledge platform for pumped storage power station is to make full use of the experiential knowledge accumulated over a long period of time to provide a more effective organization, management and decision support ability. Firstly, this paper elaborates the definition, development, and architecture of the knowledge platform, then the key technologies and overall workflow of the knowledge platform are described in detail. Finally, some practical application scenarios are introduced and analyzed which has a certain reference value for the construction and application of knowledge platform for pumped storage power station.

articleTitle: Segmentation of Metastatic Lesions in Radionuclide Bone Imaging Based on an Improved Attention U-Net Model
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: The automatic segmentation of metastatic lesions in radionuclide bone imaging holds significant clinical importance. To reliably and accurately segment metastatic lesions in radionuclide bone imaging, this paper presents an enhanced lesion segmentation model based on the Attention U-Net architecture. To augment the feature extraction capability from input images, a Depthwise Separable Convolutional Attention module was constructed. It utilizes depthwise separable convolutions to enhance the extraction of lower-level semantic features from input images and incorporates the CBAM to emphasize attention towards spatial and channel information. Addressing the challenge posed by varying sizes of lesions in radionuclide bone imaging and the emphasis on extracting vital channel feature information, a Multi-scale Convolution of Attention module was developed. It employs multi-scale convolutions combined with a channel attention mechanism to enhance the extraction and preservation of bone scan image features. Experiments on a real clinical dataset of radionuclide bone imaging achieved a Dice Similarity Coefficient (DSC) evaluation metric of 0.7044. The results indicate that the model exhibits excellent performance in segmenting metastatic lesions and holds substantial clinical diagnostic value.

articleTitle: Improved Human Optimisation Algorithm for Global Path Planning in AGV
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: Aiming at the problems of slow convergence speed of human learning algorithm for optimum search, low accuracy of the optimization search, low efficiency of the path search, and lack of security in path planning, a diligent human learning optimal algorithm that integrates the particle swarm algorithm and the improved HLO algorithm is proposed. The improved algorithm is applied to global path planning, and simulation experiments prove the feasibility of the improved algorithm in AGV path planning, which has faster convergence speed and shorter planning path length than the traditional algorithm, and can effectively reduce the number of algorithm iterations.

articleTitle: Dual Encoders Neural Network for Medical Image Segmentation
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: In the field of medical image segmentation, UNet has emerged as a widely utilized backbone network architecture. The emergence of deep learning techniques such as convolutional neural networks (CNNs), attention mechanisms, and Transformer has provided a foundation for building newer and more powerful versions of UNet. The pure CNNs-based UNet has demonstrated excellent performance in medical image segmentation, and recently, the pure Transformer-based UNet has achieved even better segmentation results. Owing to their local inductive bias, CNNs excel at capturing local features and generate fine but potentially incomplete results, whereas Transformers excel at capturing global context and generate complete but less detailed results. Recently, some studies have explored the integration of CNNs and Transformers, achieving promising performance. In this paper, we introduce a novel dual encoders architecture that combines Swin Transformer and CNNs. Unlike prior methods, our architecture comprises two distinct sets of encoders: one leveraging Swin Transformer and the other utilizing CNNs. Furthermore, a spatial-channel attention-based fusion(SCAF) module is designed to effectively fuse the outputs. These innovative designs empower our network to effectively grasp both global context and local textural details, thereby enhancing the performance of medical image segmentation. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed method outperforms previous state-of-the-art methods on both the Synapse multi-organ CT dataset and the ACDC dataset.

articleTitle: DDPG-based control strategy for sedimentation process in mud of rake suction dredger
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: Aiming at the low yield problem caused by the serious reliance on manual experience operation in the mud deposition process of rake suction dredger, this paper proposes a control strategy based on the DDPG algorithm for the mud deposition process, which can realize the intelligent control of the mud deposition process according to the current construction state. Firstly the mechanism of sediment deposition process of rake suction dredger is analysed and modelled. Secondly, the DDPG algorithm is used to fully explore the process in a sediment deposition modelling environment. The experimental results show that the strategy reduces the overflow loss and increases the sediment deposition volume by adjusting the overflow barrel height, inlet flow rate and inlet density in real time to optimize the yield.

articleTitle: A microservice workflow scheduling algorithm based on dynamic resource selection strategy
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: To solve the problem of high overall scheduling cost in existing cloud based workflow scheduling algorithms when facing a large number of microservice tasks, a microservice workflow scheduling algorithm based on dynamic resource selection strategy (DRSS) is proposed - DRSS scheduling algorithm. By utilizing the position of tasks in the workflow to determine their sub deadlines and scheduling priorities, a dynamic resource selection strategy is adopted to schedule tasks and obtain the optimal resources for task execution. Based on this, the task status and resource vector of virtual machine instances are updated. The experimental results show that this algorithm is superior to similar algorithms in terms of scheduling success rate and cost.

articleTitle: A Method of Fusion of Camera and 2D Radar for Target Tracking
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: Fusion of camera and 2D radar is a low-cost method to achieve target tracking. This paper firstly gives the flow of image tracking and radar tracking respectively, then gives the method of evaluating the results of image tracking and radar tracking, and finally gives the fusion strategy and angle conversion method of tracking results. This paper describes in detail that fusing camera and 2D radar is a low-cost method to achieve target tracking, and verifies the feasibility of the method through experiments.

articleTitle: Research on the framework of low-cost wide-domain Question-Answering system based on knowledge graph
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: Knowledge graph-based question-answering (KBQA) systems suffer from problems such as low-quality datasets and limited categories of candidate entities, which lead to difficulties in system construction and limited applications. To address this problem, a low-cost wide-domain KBQA system construction framework called LCWD-QA is proposed by combining deep learning, knowledge graphs, and large language models. First, an entity span prediction model was designed to recognize potential entity mentions in sentences. Then, the concept of entity popularity is introduced, and an entity-linking algorithm is designed to link entity mentions to specific entities in the knowledge graph. Finally, the Bert style of text classification models was used for intent recognition, and then different methods were used to generate the answer to that question. In addition, large language models were used to enhance the experimental dataset and generate supplementary answers to the knowledge graph to improve the generalization of the system. The experimental results show that the LCWD-QA system presented in this paper exhibits good performance on both entity span prediction and intent recognition subtasks, with an accuracy of 99.5%, which is better than that of the prevalent benchmark models. The system avoids the high dependence of traditional named entity recognition schemes on manually labeled datasets and has high accuracy and interpretability, which has high application and reference value.

articleTitle: Fault Diagnosis of Power Transformer Based on Improved Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: To detect the latent fault of a power transformer before it is too late and improve the accuracy of fault diagnosis, this paper proposes a fault diagnosis method for power transformers based on a BP neural network with improved particle swarm optimization (IPSO). First of all, to solve the problem that particle swarm optimization (PSO) is prone to premature and oscillatory phenomena, an improved particle swarm optimization is proposed by randomly varying the inertia weight of PSO and nonlinearly changing the learning factor of PSO so that it can jump out of the local optimum. Then, IPSO is used to globally optimize the initial weights and thresholds of the BP neural network, and the optimized BP neural network is applied to power transformer fault diagnosis. Finally, by training and testing the transformer fault sample data of substations and power plants and comparing it with BPNN and PSO-BPNN models, further verification is carried out by using the data of six groups of power grid companies that have clearly defined the cause of transformer failure. The results show that the IPSO-BPNN model performs better than BPNN and PSO-BPNN in power transformer fault diagnosis. The method presented in this paper has important reference significance for intelligent fault diagnosis of power transformers and other high-voltage electrical equipment.

articleTitle: A Robust Image Stitching Based on Solution Set Smoothing
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: The importance of a smooth warp field in image stitching is on the rise. Existing techniques like as-projective-as-possible (APAP) and adaptive as-natural-as-possible (AANAP), which rely on Direct Linear Transformation, leverage smooth projection fields to enhance alignment and naturalness in image stitching. Nonetheless, experiments reveal their lackluster computational efficiency. In this study, we propose a robust as-fast-as-possible image stitching based on solution set smoothing, which focuses on both accuracy and computational efficiency of image stitching. We take the matched feature point pairs as the initial seed for the warping field. We first compute the base set of precise warping parameters for each seed. Then, we filter outliers in the solution space and weight all precise solutions to obtain the locally optimal solution, and finally obtain the overall warping field by inverse distance interpolation. The experimental results show that our algorithm outperforms the state-of-the-art algorithms in terms of computational performance, and the quality and naturalness of the alignment reach the same level.

articleTitle: Research on robot path planning based on sparrow search algorithm integrating multiple strategies
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: The sparrow search algorithm ( SSA ) has some problems in the research of robot obstacle avoidance. It is difficult to jump out of the local optimum in advance, the initial population distribution is not wide enough, and the search accuracy is low. An improved sparrow search algorithm (Sparrow Search Algorithm Combining Butterfly Search and Triangle Walk ,BTSSA) is proposed by introducing a cubic chaotic map to obtain the initial population, introducing a butterfly algorithm and a triangular step strategy to update the individual position, and using a cubic spline curve method to smooth the path.

articleTitle: Analysis of Anti-Multipath Methods Based on Maritime Channels
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: A geometry-based dual-cylinder scatterer channel model is proposed for the communication scenario between unmanned aerial vehicles and small mobile platforms on the water surface. The position of a cylindrical scatterer varies with the position of the transmitting and receiving ends. This model combines the line-of-sight propagation path, the cylindrical single-reflection path, and the cylindrical double-reflection path. In the face of inter-symbol interference caused by multipath effects in maritime radio propagation, adaptive equalizers and new modulation techniques were used to solve the problem, and the anti-interference performance of different methods was simulated and analyzed.

articleTitle: Road damage detection algorithm based on optimised You Only Look Once version 8
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: Automatic detection and identification of road damage is of vital importance for the prevention of traffic accidents.
