AcawebAgent offers customized research reports that include indepth overviews, practical applications, the latest developments, and future trajectories of specific research domains, thereby significantly diminishing the time and effort needed for comprehensive literature reviews and trend analyses.

articleTitle: An FPGA-based QC-LDPC encoder design
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: Low-density parity-check (LDPC) codes have been widely used to deal with noise interference and improve the reliability of the system due to their excellent error correction performance. At the same time, with the increase of storage density in digital storage devices, LDPC codes are also applied to the error checking and correcting (ECC) module to solve the situation of random flipping of stored data bits. In this paper, the progressive edge growing (PEG) algorithm is used to construct a high-rate Quasi Cyclic-LDPC (QC-LDPC) code suitable for the ECC module of the storage device, and the generator matrix is analyzed, and finally a high-efficiency encoder is designed based on the FPGA to quickly generate the parity-check bits in the storage device. The encoder in this study can achieve a throughput of 106.4Mbps at a 50MHz clock.

articleTitle: Rock CT Image Segmentation Based on Transfer Learning and U-Net
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: In this study, we delve into the performance nuances of U-Net and its variants through transfer learning in rock image segmentation. Employing a robust rock image dataset alongside standard evaluation metrics, our analysis unveils the distinctive capabilities of each network variant. The experimental outcomes reveal the diverse efficacy of these networks in segmentation tasks, guiding the selection process based on specific application needs. Particularly, Swin-Unet emerges as a balanced option for achieving high accuracy with computational efficiency, while AttUnet demonstrates superiority in processing complex textured rock images. These nuanced recommendations aim to aid researchers in choosing the most fitting network for enhancing segmentation precision and efficiency in rock image analysis, offering valuable insights for both academic and practical advancements in this domain.

articleTitle: Implementation of Delay Retransmission Algorithm for WSN Neighbor Detection Conflict Avoidance
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: In Wireless Sensor Network communication, in order to realize network topology control and point-to-point communication, it is necessary to find out the identity of neighbor nodes. WSN works at a low duty cycle and there is a communication channel congestion conflict when multiple neighbors are detected at the same time. In this study, the WSN communication method of time-delayed retransmission neighbor discovery is adopted, the neighbor node is discovered by three-way handshake, and the binary delay mechanism is adopted to avoid communication collisions. First, the master node sends the broadcast packet, containing the identity of the master node itself. Then, the neighbor node gets the broadcast packet, adds its own identity, and sends the response packet to the master node by avoiding the delay. When the master node obtains the response packet of the neighbor node, it obtains the identity of the neighbor node and sends the confirmation packet to the neighbor node. The algorithm comes into force on WSN hardware, and the neighbor discovery is completed and the point-to-point communication to the specified neighbor is successfully realized.

articleTitle: Design and Analysis of Majority Logic-Based Approximate 5:2 Compressors and Multipliers
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: Approximate computing based on majority logic (ML) is an effective solution for achieving high-performance computing and saving resources of real-time applications. This paper we propose novel designs of four approximate 5:2 compressors using three different techniques. These new designs can achieve simpler circuit structures and minimize output errors. Compared to similar designs, the proposed approximate 5:2 compressors achieve a 58% increase in accuracy. Furthermore, a unique partial product compression circuit is constructed based on the proposed approximate 5:2 compressor, leading to an efficient approximate multiplier design. Compared to previous designs, the four proposed approximate multipliers reduce the normalized average error distance by 41.3%. In addition, the feasibility of the proposed approximate 5:2 compressor and multiplier was verified using the QCADesigner platform. The proposed approximate 5:2 compressors exhibit an average decrease in area of 68.5% compared to previous designs. Moreover, the proposed approximate multiplier was applied to image multiplication using MATLAB. It was found that compared to previous similar designs, the proposed method achieved a 27.2% improvement in peak signal-to-noise ratio (PSNR) and a 12.6% improvement in the structural similarity index (SSIM), resulting in higher-quality images.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of a Multi-Channel Fiber Optic Communication System Based on Domestic SOPC
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: To ensure stable, efficient communication and reliable data transmission among various modules of the high-voltage programmable power supply, a multi-channel fiber optic communication system based on domestic SOPC was designed and implemented using a domestic FPGA as the carrier. An ARM Cortex-M1 soft-core processor was embedded in the Gowin FPGA to control peripherals and interact with the host computer. Multiple-channel data processing and arbitration modules were designed using Verilog HDL. These modules, along with Serdes interface and SFP optical modules, were utilized to construct the communication system. Test results demonstrate that the system meets the requirements of isolated communication for high-voltage programmable power supplies, ensuring stable and reliable communication for extended periods in environments with multiple channels and mixed priority levels.

articleTitle: Research on Measuring Vehicle Outline Dimensions by Fusing Vision and Laser Point Clouds
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: The modification and overloading of vehicles have been persistently prohibited in highway transportation, becoming a significant factor affecting traffic safety. It severely disrupts public transportation order and directly threatens the safety of people's lives and properties. To address the low accuracy of measuring vehicle outline dimensions and the difficulty in segmenting vehicle components using purely image or point cloud data, a method is proposed that integrates laser point clouds and vision for measuring car outlines and components. The approach involves mapping the 3D point cloud model of the vehicle collected by the laser radar to a 2D plane, identifying and extracting feature points from the 2D projected image, matching the color information of the vehicle captured by the coaxial camera with the corresponding laser point cloud to merge the measured vehicle's laser point cloud model with the camera-captured image for 3D model reconstruction. This enables the identification, segmentation, and measurement of vehicle and external features.

articleTitle: Visual SLAM Method Based on Motion Segmentation
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: Traditional simultaneous localization and mapping (SLAM) algorithms are prone to interference from dynamic objects in real-world scenarios, resulting in poor algorithm robustness and low localization accuracy. In this paper, a visual SLAM method based on motion segmentation is proposed, building upon the ORB-SLAM3 framework. First, introducing a motion segmentation method Rigidmask to detect potential dynamic objects and generate dynamic object mask images, which combines geometric constraints, optical flow estimation, and depth estimation techniques. Meanwhile, YOLO-World is employed for instance segmentation to obtain object mask images. Subsequently, correspondence matching between the two types of mask images is conducted to enhance motion segmentation accuracy. Finally, the dynamic feature points are eliminated, and the remaining feature points are used for pose matching and estimation. Experimental results on the TUM data set show that compared with ORBSLAM3, under highly dynamic sequences, the absolute trajectory error (ATE) of this method is increased by more than 89%. At the same time, compared with some current mainstream visual SLAM algorithms in dynamic scenes, the positioning accuracy has also been improved.

articleTitle: X-Module: An Plug-and-Play Edge Enhancement Module Based on Connectivity Data
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: In the field of image segmentation, addressing the limitations of existing techniques in capturing both edge details and global information in images, this paper innovatively develops a novel image segmentation algorithm module named X-Module. This technology integrates finely tailored and reassembled feature maps, deep analysis of edge connectivity, and efficient hierarchical convolutional structures, achieving significant enhancement and refinement of edge information in images. Through testing on a series of publicly available datasets using the integrated segmentation network with X-Module, the results demonstrate that this technology exhibits significant advantages over existing techniques, particularly in improving the accuracy of image segmentation and performance in edge processing, showcasing better detail recovery and object recognition capabilities.

articleTitle: Visualization Platform based on GraphX
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: This paper develops a visualization platform based on GraphX, aiming to provide users with an intuitive and efficient graph data analysis experience. The platform is developed using mainstream front-end and back-end frameworks, ensuring a user-friendly interface and smooth interaction. In addition, in order to achieve large-scale graph data rendering, WebGL related technologies are used for efficient rendering. Finally, the effectiveness and feasibility of the visualization platform are evaluated through experiments.

articleTitle: Research on equalization control of lithium-ion battery pack based on SOC
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: Due to the differences in the manufacturing process and assembly methods of lithium-ion batteries for electric vehicles, it is very easy to produce the problem of power inconsistency after forming a group, so it is necessary to control the equalization of lithium-ion battery packs. In this paper, based on the analysis and comparison of various equalization topologies, an active equalization topology based on flyback transformer is proposed, and the SOC (state of charge) of lithium-ion battery is used as the equalization variable to formulate the corresponding equalization strategy. Finally, the effectiveness of the equalization scheme is verified under simulation conditions under three different operating conditions of lithium-ion battery charging, discharging and shelving, which proves that the equalization scheme has high efficiency and can effectively improve the inconsistency problem of lithium-ion battery packs.

articleTitle: User Behavior Portrait of Express Delivery in China University Campus: with Internet big data
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: Due to the increasing of campus e-commerce customers, behavior portrait can help service suppliers grasp the market demand better and develop targeted service strategies. Based on the SERVQUAL model, an indicator system was established, and the K-Means algorithm was used for clustering. The survey was administered from March 23 to March 28, 2023, resulting in a total of 1099 responses. It is found that there are four types of campus express users. We can provide targeted services according to the type, such as for type-1 we should improve the storage function, and for type-4 we should provide professional express packaging protection, etc.

articleTitle: Engine Integration Using WebGL Depth Buffer and Rendering Method for Digital Twin Models
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: In recent years, with the continuous development of digital twin technology, its application scope has become increasingly widespread across various fields. Currently, static WebGIS applications built on the open-source 3D mapping framework Cesium fail to effectively showcase the dynamic process of model changes and struggle to seamlessly integrate models with environmental elements, thereby limiting the flexibility and applicability of digital twin applications in practical construction. To address this issue, this paper proposes an engine integration method based on depth buffering, aiming to achieve a depth integration between Cesium and general 3D rendering engines, thereby effectively enhancing Cesium’s model rendering capabilities in WebGIS application development. Furthermore, through in-depth exploration of graphic rendering algorithms, we have designed scene visualization algorithms applicable to different environmental parameters, achieving effective integration of models with environmental elements and successfully simulating the process of model dynamic changes.

articleTitle: A CNN-Transformer model for short Chinese texts sentiment analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: Sentiment analysis of short Chinese texts holds significance in preventing cyber bullying and fostering a favorable network environment. Due to the limited contextual information they contain, sentiment analysis of short Chinese texts presents a level of difficulty. Existing methods have typically focus on either traditional pipeline method or deep learning methods, e.g. Transformer. However, they are inadequate to capture specific local features and have high computational complexity when processing sequences. To resolve the above constraints, this paper introduces a convolutional neural network structure with stronger local feature extraction capability to improve Transformer. The CNN-Transformer model is proposed, which achieves a well balance between learning both local sentiment features and global sentiment information. Furthermore, we construct a novel Chinese dataset for short Chinese texts sentiment analysis specifically, which contains 80,000 comments from a variety of sources. Extensive experiments and ablation studies on three benchmarks demonstrate that the proposed CNN-Transformer model consistently outperforms the existing methods.

articleTitle: SE-TDN-LSTM speaker recognition algorithm based on residual connection
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: To address the issues of low performance and poor robustness of TDNN based on complex conditions in capturing contextual feature information and processing noise, the SE-TDNN-LSTM speaker recognition model based on residual connection is proposed. The model first utilizes the SE-TDNN module to extract local features of speech signals, and enhances their local importance to suppress the influence of redundant information such as noise; Secondly, the residual connection is applied for feature information sharing, and the learned multi-scale features are transmitted to the LSTM-TDNN module to capture long-term dependencies and extract higher-level features, to complete the modeling of contextual global information; Finally, frame-level feature aggregation is performed through a statistical pooling layer with an attention mechanism to obtain speaker features with higher discriminability. The experimental results on the unconstrained Chinese speech dataset of CN-Celeb show that the SE-TDNN-LSTM speaker recognition model based on residual connection reduces the equal error rate (EER) and minimum normalized detection cost function(minDCF) by 2.80% and 0.135 respectively compared to the X-vectors model, achieving an EER of 11.41% and a minDCF of 0.494, and has high accuracy and robustness.

articleTitle: A High-Performance Bearing Fault Diagnosis Enhancement Method in High Noise Environments Based on PSO-Optimized VMD-MCKD
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: Addressing the challenge of extracting faint fault features of rolling bearings in environments with substantial background noise, this study introduces a novel diagnostic method for bearing faults. This method harnesses a Particle Swarm Optimization algorithm to sequentially fine-tune two parameters of Variational Mode Decomposition (VMD), [α, K], and three parameters of Maximum Correlation Kurtosis Deconvolution (MCKD), [L, T, M]. Utilizing the bearing fault data from Case Western Reserve University, this approach has been substantiated to significantly mitigate noise interference and accentuate faint fault features in high-noise settings. The experimental outcomes affirm that this method effectively extracts subtle fault characteristics, thereby enhancing the precision and reliability of fault diagnosis.

articleTitle: 3D-aware neural network for analyzing neuron morphology
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: With the continuous development of neuron reconstruction techniques, biologists can acquire neuron morphology data in large quantities. However, the vastness and richness of the data pose significant challenges for quantification and analysis tasks. In this paper, we propose an end-to-end 3D-aware neuron morphology analyzing model to extract morphological features. This method is able to capture the 3D relationships present in neuronal morphology data, thereby extracting cell-type-discriminative morphological features through an end-to-end pipeline. We tested our model with over 1,600 neuron morphology data collected from NeuroMorpho on classification and retrieval tasks. Our method is effective in both classifying neuronal cell types and retrieving neurons with similar morphology.

articleTitle: Partial Order Clustering and Its Hybridization with Intelligent Optimization Algorithm for An Application to Multi-task Assignment
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: This paper proposes an intelligent optimization clustering strategy based on partial order clustering to address the issue of conditional clustering, presenting a novel higher-order clustering method. Simultaneously, aiming to enhance the efficiency of multi-task assignment, the algorithm is applied to solve large-scale task assignment problems. Initially, a partial order table is established based on the distances between each point's coordinates and all centroids, which utilizes the partial order clustering method to allocate all points to their corresponding clusters while meeting clustering constraints. Subsequently, an improved intelligent algorithm optimizes the centroids of the partial order clustering, reducing the dimensionality of the optimization problem and enabling rapid determination of the optimal solution. Numerical simulation results demonstrate that the proposed algorithm can rapidly solve conditional clustering problems while also efficiently addressing large-scale multi-task assignment problems.

articleTitle: Cloud Desktop Frame Rate Enhancement Based on Video Frame Interpolation
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: In response to the high consumption of server-side hardware and network resources caused by high frame rate acquisition in cloud desktops, a video interpolation method based on the U-Net architecture is proposed. This method can perform real-time frame interpolation on the video data transmitted from the server at the client side, improving the smoothness of the video. The proposed model has a simple structure and real-time capability, can integrate features at multiple scales, and utilize the inter-frame correlation to complete video frame interpolation. Additionally, this paper addresses the frequently occurring occlusion issues in cloud desktops and simulates the usage scenarios of desktop cloud computing commonly found in data analysis software in physics research, creating a dataset named DesktopSet. Experimental results demonstrate that compared to other real-time frame interpolation models, the proposed model achieves a PSNR of 30.58 dB at a resolution of 720p, with improvements ranging from 3.62 to 6.93 dB. The SSIM index reaches 0.9640, with improvements ranging from 0.2057 to 0.1339, and the LPIPS index reaches 0.0274, with improvements ranging from 0.097 to 0.0121. The video frame interpolation method proposed in this paper meets real-time requirements while delivering better visual quality in cloud desktop.

articleTitle: Implementation of a small-scale intelligent water management supervision system
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: The intelligent water affairs supervision system adopts a lightweight microservices framework and a development model based on front-end and back-end separation, namely the Spring Cloud+Vue system development framework, to design and implement a feasible small-scale water monitoring and management system. Analysis shows that this model can reduce software development cycles, lower development costs,improve system efficiency and scalability, and the stable operation of the system also proves the security and feasibility of its development framework.

articleTitle: Robot Automatic Wire Welding Based on Machine Vision
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: Currently, the welding process between electrical connectors and multi-core wires mainly relies on manual operation. This traditional method not only consumes a lot of time and manpower, but also long-term operation may cause certain physical burden and health hazards to the operator. Therefore, researching and implementing automated welding between electrical connectors and multi-core wires has become an urgent problem to be solved. On the basis of summarizing the current research status at home and abroad, the software and hardware parts of the system were designed to meet the requirements of identifying and positioning welding circular electrical connectors. By introducing image processing and machine vision technology, adopting a dual machine collaboration approach and based on machine vision methods, automatic wire welding of electrical connectors has been achieved, improving welding efficiency and reducing the labor intensity of operators. In addition, it is also conducive to promoting the development of industrial automation.

articleTitle: Finite-time Dissipative Control for a Kind of Nonlinear Systems with Time-delay T-S Fuzzy Model
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: The finite- time dissipative control problem of time-delay T-S fuzzy singular systems was studied to address the instability and poor system performance caused by time delay in control systems. Using Lyapunov stability theory, finite-time theory, matrix scaling theory and linear matrix inequality, A sufficient condition was provided to ensure that the closed-loop system is bounded in -finite time and meets the dissipative performance index, Obtained the design method of the controller, The proposed method can maintain the system state within a predetermined range for a limited time, Numerical examples demonstrate the effectiveness and feasibility of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Research on Optimization Technologies of ARM Server Oriented SPECWeb Benchmark Testing
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: Web servers play an essential role in Internet services, their performances directly affect the speed and experience of users access to websites. SPECweb2009 is a kind of web server testing benchmark developed by the global third-party nonprofit organization SPEC (Standard Performance Evaluation Corporation), use for evaluating web server performance. This study focuses on ARM architecture servers, proposes and validate the key technologies of benchmark testing implementation and optimization by experiments, and provides important references for launching performance evaluation, capacity planning, configuration selection of ARM architecture web servers.

articleTitle: Robust Super-resolution Based on Selective Samples
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: We propose a robust super-resolution algorithm based on internal and external sample selection, which can effectively alleviate the false information caused by ill-conditioned external training set. Our algorithm introduces an "arbitrator" to select more reliable samples for the reconstruction model learning, and integrates the internal learning and external learning into a unified framework. Experiments demonstrate that our algorithm can obtain stable and high quality results with no requirement for the relevancy of external samples. Further, we propose an accelerated version, which is a very practical reconstruction algorithm with high efficiency and strong robustness.

articleTitle: Optimization of weight update for convolutional operators for domestic accelerators
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: Convolutional neural networks play an important role in deep learning, which includes three processes: forward propagation, backpropagation, and weight update. On domestic heterogeneous accelerators, the performance of the weight update operator is somewhat weak. In this paper, we handwritten and optimized the weight update operator on domestic heterogeneous accelerators, including both ordinary convolution and grouped convolution. Among them, ordinary convolution uses the implicit gemm algorithm, Grouped convolution uses a parallelized direct convolution algorithm, which reduces memory usage and has strong universality. Parallel direct convolution algorithms make better use of it.

articleTitle: Resilience evaluation method of combat System-of-Systems based on hierarchical structure
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: With the innovative development of combat styles, modern warfare has evolved into a confrontation between combat System-of-Systems (SoS). A resilient combat SoS can reduce the loss of capability and achieve rapid recovery in the event of an attack. We innovatively propose a resilience evaluation method of combat SoS based on hierarchical structure, and establish a hierarchical structure for evaluating SoS capability, which is ranked from high to low as capability layer, activity layer, and system layer. Bayesian networks are used to establish mapping relationships between different layers, and the evolution process of SoS capability is obtained based on dynamic Bayesian networks. In addition, a resilience evaluation index based on the evolution process of SoS capability is proposed.

articleTitle: Research on Business Consistency Verification Techniques for Energy Big Data Privacy Protection
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: In this paper, we study the consistency verification technology for multi-party collaborative privacy-preserving operations of energy big data, and propose a consistency assessment algorithm based on minimum hash signatures for the privacy and consistency challenges in energy big data processing. The algorithm realizes the assessment of the consistency of the target dataset through data compression and signature design of the data source, avoids direct access to the original data, and guarantees data privacy and consistency of processing results. The experimental results show that the algorithm is able to effectively assess data consistency on energy big datasets such as electricity and gas consumption, and the results are close to the exact algorithm with high credibility and efficiency.

articleTitle: Optimal control of high-speed train speed tracking based on improved whale algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: Aiming at the high-speed train operation tracking control problem, a sliding mode control algorithm based on the improved whale algorithm of RBF neural network is proposed. Firstly, we establish a single mass point model of the train and control it by integral sliding mode; meanwhile, we introduce the adaptive algorithm of RBF neural network to weaken the influence of external interference and prove the feasibility of the controller by Lyapunov stability criterion; finally, in order to strengthen the global searching and local optimization ability of the whale algorithm, we carry out the nonlinear processing of the convergence factor of the whale algorithm, and optimize the parameters of the controller through the optimization strategy of the improved whale algorithm. Optimization. The simulation results show that the speed error is within the range of [–0.7×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">–3</sup> , 3.8×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">–3</sup> ] and the displacement error is within the range of [–3.5×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">–4</sup>, 5.2×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">–4</sup>], and the algorithm can realize the accurate tracking of train speed and displacement.

articleTitle: Head Detection Method Based on Binocular Stereo Vision
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: Binocular stereo vision technology is a critical area of research in computer vision, with widespread applications across various domains. Addressing the need for real-time crowd flow statistics, this study presents a head detection algorithm utilizing images captured by binocular cameras. The approach involves initial image rectification followed by analysis using binocular disparity and visual target acquisition algorithms. It further identifies head contours by examining depth profiles, depth map characteristics, and geometric features of the head's circular top area obtained from binocular stereo imaging. This method employs a depth-layered approach to extract head presence information, leveraging the circular head outline as a key geometric feature for recognition through a binocular stereo vision matching algorithm. The process efficiently detects head contours under binocular vision, resulting in high accuracy and speed in head detection within complex environments.

articleTitle: Aspect-level Sentiment Analysis based on Prompt Templates and External Knowledge
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: Aspect-based sentiment analysis (ABSA) is a fine-grained sentiment analysis task aimed at identifying and evaluating sentiment expressions in text or speech while considering the relationships between multiple aspects of sentiment. Recent research trends favor the adoption of end-to-end frameworks to address ABSA tasks in a unified manner. However, these frameworks can be fine-tuned for downstream tasks without requiring any task-specific adaptations. Specifically, they fail to effectively leverage task-specific knowledge. To address this issue, this chapter proposes an aspect-level sentiment analysis approach that integrates prompt knowledge to enhance the model's perception of downstream tasks and strengthen the semantic interaction between aspect words and context. Firstly, the concept and types of prompt learning are elaborated. Then, the designed model network structure is introduced, which consists of three components: prompt text construction layer, semantic encoding layer, and sentiment label word mapping layer. Subsequently, the design methods and implementation processes of each module are described. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed approach is validated through comparative experiments on publicly available datasets.

articleTitle: Enhancing Indoor Positioning with Acoustic Signal-Aided Visual-Inertial SLAM
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: To address the issue of long-term trajectory drift caused by cumulative errors in visual-inertial SLAM for indoor positioning scenarios, we propose a method that augments visual-inertial SLAM with acoustic signal. Specifically, we employ factor graph optimization to incorporate acoustic ranging and relative velocity measurements as global factors into the SLAM system for joint optimization, aiming to reduce cumulative errors and improve accuracy. Benefiting from the use of TOA and FOA positioning methods in the acoustic component, our proposed method is of significant importance for indoor scenarios with obstructions and low beacon density. We validate our positioning method by simulating with acoustic measurements on the public dataset EuRoC. The experimental results demonstrate that compared to pure visual-inertial SLAM, our method achieves superior performance in positioning accuracy, proving the effectiveness of this approach in reducing long-term trajectory drift.

articleTitle: Controller tuning via constrained Bayesian optimization
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: Controller parameter tuning is always faced challenges due to the complexity of the dynamic system. Even for professional control practitioners, hand-tuning task is time-consuming and tedious, wasting a lot of time and unable to find the optimal parameters. In this paper, an automatic tuning method using constrained Bayesian optimization is proposed. Firstly, the concept of MPC controller tuning is introduced. Secondly, the constrained Bayesian optimization and how to solve controller tuning problem is proposed. Finally, the proposed method is validated in Shell Heavy Oil Fractionator. Experimental results show that proposed automatic tuning method can achieve good performance with only a small number of evaluations is superior to traditional method.

articleTitle: Research on the Price Prediction Model of the Used New Energy Vehicles Based on PCA-PSO-BP Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: A BP neural network evaluation model based on principal component analysis and particle swarm optimisation algorithm (PCA-PSO-BP) is proposed to address the problems of single selection indicators, excessive reliance on manual detection, and large evaluation error in the existing residual value evaluation of used new energy vehicles. Firstly, the principal component analysis method is used to screen out the most important feature indicators that affect the residual value of new energy vehicles. Then, the particle swarm optimization algorithm is used to optimize the weights and thresholds of the BP neural network. Finally, the selected features are input into the optimized BP neural network to output the residual value evaluation result.The results indicate that the PCA-PSO-BP neural network residual value evaluation model has high prediction accuracy and can provide reference for the current state of the art. The results indicate that the PCA-PSO-BP neural network residual value evaluation model has high prediction accuracy and can provide reference for the current residual value evaluation methods of second-hand new energy vehicles.

articleTitle: Network Anomaly Detection Algorithm Based on Fusion of Artificial Fish Swarming and Isolation Forest
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: Currently, network security involves all aspects of human life privacy, etc., and anomalous data detection has been an important means of protection against network attacks. Aiming at the problem of unreasonable allocation of voting weights of different isolation trees in isolation forest, an isolation forest algorithm based on artificial fish swarming is proposed. The artificial fish swarming algorithm(AFSA) has a strong global search capability for the problem space solution, and in the stage of calculating the anomaly score, the artificial fish swarming algorithm is used to optimise the weight of the isolation trees in isolation forest, increase the weight of isolation trees with high detection accuracy, and reduce the weight of isolation trees with low detection accuracy, so as to ultimately improve the accuracy of the detection of anomalous data. In this paper ,we conduct comparative experiments with Probabilistic Generalization of Isolation Forest(PGIF) and Isolation Forest(IForest) on the ODDS anomaly detection dataset and network intrusion detection dataset. The experimental results show that the present algorithm improves the average AUC value by 6% and 5% on the ODDS dataset and NSL-KDD dataset, respectively.

articleTitle: Teacher Speech Recognition in Smart Classrooms of Colleges and Universities Based on Audio-To-Text Conversion and Keyword Matching
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: Automatic identification of key words in teachers' audio in smart classrooms of colleges and universities and automatic identification of teachers' video behaviors are a new attempt in the evaluation of teaching quality of college teachers. Based on the massive audio and video data generated by smart classrooms, a continuously updated keyword library is first constructed, and then the teacher's audio is converted into text using a private cloud and a separately developed audio-to-text model. Finally, a text keyword matching model is constructed using Python3.9 to realize the identification of key words such as teachers' ethics, classroom management, course-based ideological and political education, and teaching emphasis and difficulty in the audio of college teachers' teaching. Based on this model and the automatic identification model of teachers' video behaviors, an attempt is made to automatically, fully, and objectively evaluate the teaching quality of college teachers in smart classrooms, and to solve the difficulties and pain points in the traditional evaluation of the teaching quality of college smart classroom teachers.

articleTitle: D-Bi-LSTM: A double Bi-LSTM-based method for metro ridership prediction
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: Metro ridership forecasting is instrumental in the operation, scheduling, and safety of public transportation. As an effective method of capturing sequential relationships, Long Short-Term Memory Network (LSTM) has been broadly adopted for traffic forecasting. However, in metro networks, due to the highly regular nature of metro ridership, the spatial features aggregated from other stations still contain sequential information, which is ignored in existing studies. To this end, this paper proposes a novel model which aims to employ Double Bidirectional LSTM (D-Bi-LSTM) to capture the sequential correlations of both temporal and spatial features of metro ridership. Firstly, based on the regularity of metro ridership, different temporal patterns are integrated as the input features. Secondly, the similarity graph and the adjacency graph are utilized to capture the spatial features between metro stations. Finally, the sequential correlations of both temporal and spatial features of metro ridership are captured by employing Bi-LSTM in spatial and temporal directions, respectively. Experimental results conducted on two large metro datasets demonstrate that the proposed model has superiority compared to four widely recognized models.

articleTitle: A Color Image Encryption Method Based on Cross-Scanning and Inter-Plane Shuffling
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: This paper proposes a new color image encryption method based on cross-traversal and inter-plane disruption. First, the SHA-512 hash function is used to generate the key from the plaintext image, and chaotic sequences A1, A2 and A3 are produced using the one-dimensional Logistic system, one-dimensional Sine mapping system and two-dimensional Henon mapping system. Then, cross-traversal is performed on the plaintext image, and intra-row disruption and inter-column disruption are carried out in turn using chaotic sequence A1 to complete the first round of disruption. Subsequently, the three bit planes are rearranged in descending order, i.e. inter-plane disruption, to complete the second round of disruption. Finally, diffusion is carried out in the diffusion stage using chaotic sequences A2 and A3 in combination with XOR operation to complete encryption. Experimental outcomes demonstrate the exceptional performance and robust security of the proposed algorithm. It effectively withstands prevalent assaults, including statistical and differential attacks, while maintaining impressive time efficiency.

articleTitle: Transferability feature recognition of university biomedical patent technology based on machine learning
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: In the era of digitalization and intelligence, identifying the transferability characteristics of biomedical patent technologies in higher education institutions is of great significance. This study takes seven intellectual property demonstration pilot universities in Shanghai as the research subjects, and constructs a biomedical patent technology transferability evaluation index system from three aspects: technical dimension, market dimension, and legal dimension. Four algorithms based on machine learning, including Support Vector Machine (SVM), Decision Tree (DT), Random Forest (RF), and Adaptive Boosting (AdaBoost), are respectively used for training and prediction. Through comparison and selection, it is finally confirmed that the Random Forest model has the best prediction effect for the constructed index system. It is considered to apply the algorithm model of this research to the massive data of biomedical industry-related patent technologies, to promote the transformation of achievements and intelligent development of the biomedical industry.

articleTitle: Predictive Control of Belt Conveyor Based on Recursive Fuzzy Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: Belt conveyors play an important role in the dry bulk material handing process. This paper presents an innovative approach to intelligent tracking and speed control for belt conveyors. The proposed method utilizes a recursive fuzzy neural network for predictive control, which is particularly effective for managing nonlinear systems and unexpected events during operation. By establishing a sparse second-order matrix model derived from the dynamic model of the belt conveyor, a recursive neural network control is designed to achieve speed tracking. To validate the effectiveness of the proposed method, simulation experiments are conducted to optimize material flow rate and speed under real working conditions. The results demonstrate a remarkable 18.4% reduction in energy consumption, highlighting the practical benefits of this approach.

articleTitle: Multimodal Automatic Personality Perception Using ViT, BiLSTM and VGGish
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: Automatic personality perception has become one of the hot research topics in the fields of psychology and affective computing in recent years. The core issue to be addressed in this research topic is how to accurately analyze an individual's psychological characteristics through their first-impression behaviors. To fully utilize the spatiotemporal information of audio and video modalities, this paper proposes a multimodal automatic personality perception method by integrating advanced deep neural network models including ViT, BiLSTM, and VGGish. In terms of video modality, the hierarchical ViT is used to extract effective features from video frames, and then BiLSTM is employed to capture the spatiotemporal information between the video frames. For the audio modality, the pretrained VGGish network is used to automatically obtain advanced audio features. Finally, the features learned from two modalities are integrated to achieve automatic recognition of personality traits. Comparative experimental results on the ChaLearn First Impressions V2 dataset show that the method proposed in this paper outperforms other methods in terms of Pearson correlation coefficient and average accuracy.

articleTitle: A study of a photovoltaic power prediction method combining BiLSTM and GWO
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: Highly accurate photovoltaic power prediction is crucial for ensuring the stability of the power system and optimizing the utilization of photovoltaic resources. To enhance the precision of solar power forecasting, this study introduces a bidirectional long short-term memory (BiLSTM) neural network model for the purpose of solar power prediction. The model incorporates hyperparameter optimization using the Gray Wolf Optimization (GWO) algorithm and integrates seven influencing factors, including temperature, barometric pressure, and humidity, to predict photovoltaic power. The BiLSTM neural network serves as the core component of the model to comprehensively capture the temporal information within the historical data of PV power generation. The GWO algorithm is employed to optimize the initial learning rate, the number of hidden layer nodes, and the number of iterations of the network model. This approach eliminates the need for manual parameter tuning, thereby preventing local optima and improving the predictive performance of the model. Finally, a simulation is conducted using the measured statistics of a photovoltaic power plant in western China. The simulation results indicate that the proposed GWO-BiLSTM model in this study achieves higher prediction accuracy compared to the traditional prediction model and the single LSTM and BiLSTM models, with R2, MAE, and RMSE values of 0.9579, 1.9657, and 3.2216, respectively.

articleTitle: Design of AE solutions for interval control systems
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: In engineering and scientific practice, models of uncertain discrete control systems can be described by interval systems and interval optimization problems over extremal algebra. A manufacture control example is given to show the motivation and the application of AE solutions. Full characterizations are established. Moreover, the concepts and characterizations of traditional solutions are also extended to max-min algebra, as special cases of AE solutions.

articleTitle: Automatic Weighing and Analysis System for Broiler Chickens Based on Mean-Shift Clustering Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: Average weight and weight uniformity are important indicators for evaluating the growth performance of broiler chickens. Currently, the assessment of average weight typically relies on manual weighing, which can stress the chickens, reduce their weight gain efficiency, and make regular manual weighing of the chickens a time-consuming and laborious task. To achieve automatic collection of chicken weights and accurately evaluate the average weight and uniformity of the chickens, this study designed an automatic weighing and analysis system for broilers based on weighing algorithms and Mean-Shift clustering analysis. The system comprises an automatic weighing module, a chicken weight monitoring and analysis system, and a supervisory control program. Through testing in an actual chicken farm and comparing the final production and sales data, the feasibility of the system was verified.

articleTitle: A Network for Detecting Changes in Remote Sensing Images Relies on Boundary Detection and Differential Enhancement
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: At present, the accuracy of the region is the primary concern in remote sensing image change detection based on deep learning. Still, the accuracy of the boundary of the changing object is ignored, which makes the result of boundary segmentation in change detection not ideal. Meanwhile, constrained by the size of the convolutional kernel, the network fails to capture the comprehensive contextual relationship among features, consequently leading to incomplete change detection results. To address the above problems, a network for detecting changes in remote sensing images relies on boundary detection and differential enhancement is proposed, named BDDE-Net. In the encoding part of the network, Transformer and multi-scale feature fusion modules are combined to capture the remote context and refine the local features. At the same time, a differential enhancement module is proposed to compare the variation difference between two feature maps. In the decoding module of the change detection network, the original feature map size is recovered by an up-sampling operation to get the change detection result map. The experimental outcomes on the LEVIRCD public dataset demonstrate that the proposed network attains superior detection accuracy and boundary segmentation outcomes.

articleTitle: A Deep Neural Network Fingerprinting Detection Method Based on Active Learning of Generative Adversarial Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: The issue of copyright protection for deep learning models is critical. We propose a novel deep neural network fingerprint detection method based on active learning of generative adversarial network (AL-GAN), which uses classifier to help generate potential fingerprint samples near the low-density boundary of normal samples to assist generative adversarial network training. The experiment results show that AL-GAN algorithm can generate informative latent fingerprint samples through GAN with active learning. It can clearly separate the fingerprint samples from training samples basing on the distance to conditional normal distribution. Meanwhile, it reduces the matching rate of model fingerprint and improves the success rate of the evasive model fingerprint inspections.

articleTitle: Research on rural landscape preference evaluation using deep learning
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: Rural roads play a vital role in connecting residents and supporting local production, influencing the overall aesthetic of villages. Despite their significance, existing rural research often overlooks the landscapes along these roads and lacks a standardized system for quantifying visual quality. Our study endeavors to fill this knowledge gap by harnessing computer vision technology to create a semantic segmentation model tailored for rural landscapes and to formulate a systematic, quantifiable index of landscape features. Employing a semantic image segmentation algorithm, we extracted physical landscape characteristics from panoramic images sourced from Changsha County. Through meticulous examination of the correlation between these measured landscape attributes and visual perception via multiple linear regression analysis, we achieved remarkable accuracy in our semantic segmentation model, reaching a precision of 83 percent. The results from the regression models highlighted the significant impact of the green vision index, farmland visibility index, building density index, and road width index on visual perception. Specifically, green vision index and farmland visibility index were positively correlated, while building density index and road width index showed negative correlations. In rural landscape planning, optimizing the balance between preserving and enhancing natural landscapes and incorporating practical, visually appealing artificial features is essential. This study presents a pioneering research framework that harnesses computer vision technology to conduct detailed and comprehensive rural landscape analyses, thereby furnishing a quantitative means of evaluating extensive rural landscapes.

articleTitle: Reducing Neural Networks Quantization Error Through the Change of Feature Correlation
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: The quantization technique of neural networks can achieve a compressed representation of models by reducing weights and activations data bitwidth, accelerating the inference process, and minimizing models' consumption of memory occupation and calculation bandwidth. However, existing quantization methods only focus on the change in weight distribution, unable to directly form a feedback relationship between network feature extraction capability and quantization function, which makes the calculation of quantization error and the adjustment of quantization parameters not reasonable, at last leads to unstable convergence and reduced accuracy. We propose a quantization-aware training (QAT) method based on feature loss, pay more attention to the impact of quantization on feature space changes, and compute the topology changes within and between sample classes. The scheme is verified to reduce the performance gap between quantized and floating-point models.

articleTitle: Research and Design of Graphic Display Technology for Embedded Devices Based on Ultra-Lightweight JavaScript Engine
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: This study proposes a graphics rendering technique based on an ultra-lightweight JavaScript engine for resource-constrained embedded devices such as ESP32. The technique achieves efficient image rendering by integrating generic low-level interfaces. The paper investigates and designs a modular system architecture that improves performance through interpreted execution of JavaScript, just-in-time (JIT) compilation, and optimized memory management, while supporting high concurrency and asynchronous I/O scheduling. Experimental evaluation shows that compared to traditional techniques, the system demonstrates significant advantages in graphics rendering speed, various types of graphics display, and resource efficiency. This study bridges the gap between the demand for high-quality graphical user interfaces (GUIs) and resource constraints in Internet of Things (IoT) devices to some extent.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Bootstrap Effect Based on Computer Simulation Technique and Improved Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: The purpose of this study is to design and implement a method to assess the investment effect of Guangdong investment funds based on improved genetic algorithm and computer simulation. First, the key factors affecting the investment effect of Guangdong investment funds are identified through literature review and market data analysis. Second, an improved genetic algorithm is proposed to optimize the portfolio allocation of GD investment funds, taking into account multiple indicators such as risk, return and liquidity. Then, computer simulation technology is utilized to conduct simulation experiments on different investment strategies of GD investment funds and evaluate their performance in different market environments. Finally, the validity and superiority of the proposed methodology of GDIF is verified through a comparative analysis with the traditional methodology. The experimental results show that the method has significant advantages in improving the investment efficiency and reducing the risk of GDIF, which can provide investors with more scientific decision-making support.

articleTitle: Research on image recognition of UAV distribution line inspection based on deep learning
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: Transmission line is an important part of the power grid, and its running state is related to the safe operation of the power grid. Using deep learning technology to identify defects in photographs taken can not only improve the efficiency of defect discovery and reduce personnel costs, but also has great prospects for deep application of deep learning technology in all aspects of defect identification of power grid transmission lines. Firstly, the method of adding spatial pyramid pooling (SPP) module under the original basic framework of YOLOv3 is proposed. Secondly, a pruning method for channel reduction and frame slimming of YOLOv3 with SPP module is proposed to reduce the calculation time. Finally, the improved algorithm is verified by using a small number of transmission line defect image data sets. The test results show that the improved model has less dependence on hardware, the detection accuracy is almost unchanged, and the average iteration time per step is reduced by 0.76 s.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Underwater Blue-Green Laser Channel Attenuation Measurement System
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: As we know, accurately measuring the attenuation value of underwater laser based communication is very difficult, and most of current researches are based on theoretical analysis and numerical simulation. In response to the complexity and variability of underwater blue-green laser communication channels, this paper studies the attenuation characteristics of underwater laser communication channels through theoretical analysis and Monte Carlo simulation methods. Moreover, a design scheme for an underwater laser attenuation channel measurement device is proposed, and the optical path and hardware system are designed to achieve actual measurement of the attenuation coefficient of underwater laser channels in a water tank environment. Finally, this paper provides theoretical basis and technical support for analyzing and establishing accurate underwater wireless laser communication channel models.

articleTitle: An enhanced spatial depth convolution and super-resolution image reconstruction algorithm for Beidou robot fire monitoring
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: The potentially catastrophic and dangerous effects of forest fires necessitate an enhancement in the detector's capability to detect small fire sources. Improving this capability is crucial for reducing biological mortality and ecosystem damage caused by forest fires. In this study, we propose a novel high-precision monitoring algorithm YOLOv8-CHS. By replacing traditional step volume and pooling layers with spatial depth conversion convolution (SPD-Conv) within the YOLOv8 detector network structure, we optimize the processing capacity for small targets and enhance flame image feature extraction efficiency in convolutional neural networks (CNNs). Additionally, we utilize lightweight upsampling operator CARAFE to improve detail retention while minimizing loss of feature image information. Furthermore, we introduce hybrid attention converter HAttention to enhance image super-resolution reconstruction performance. Comparative analysis with six other flame monitors including Faster - RCNN,SSD, YOLOv5s,centerNet, YOLOv7 - tiny and YOLOv8n demonstrates that our improved model achieves an average 4.62% increase in mean Average Precision (mAP @ [IoU = 0.5]) as well as a 4.10% increase in average precision compared to these classical algorithms. The advanced nature of the improved algorithm is confirmed by experimental results, which greatly enhance the accuracy of fire monitoring.

articleTitle: Data Analysis and Visualization for Electrical Safety Tools and Equipment
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: Electric safety tool data has the characteristics of large data volume, high dimensionality, and strong effectiveness. Traditional data analysis still has problems such as insufficient accuracy, slow processing speed, and imprecise feature selection when processing this type of data. This paper proposes a method for predicting the loss of safety tools based on classification algorithms, which provides data support for procurement by predicting the loss. In addition, a supplier scoring model based on scoring indicators was constructed to explore the potential value of the data. First, the data is characterized by construction, elimination, fusion, and reconstruction, and correlation coefficients are used for feature selection and tested on different prediction models; Secondly, a data classification model based on scoring indicators is established to form a new data dimension, including after-sales service, product quality, scale indicators, and customer feedback; Finally, visualize the data set from the perspective of the overall table and sub-tables, and the changing trends of key evaluation indicators were analyzed. This method can not only provide data for predicting the loss of electric power tools but also solve the problem of supplier evaluation and realize multi-dimensional in-depth mining and comprehensive visualization of data.

articleTitle: An Optimisation Study of Attention Mechanism for Intent Recognition of Short Texts in Transformer Framework
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: In this paper, we investigate the use of attention mechanism for short text intent recognition under the Transformer framework. The approach combines deep learning techniques with the introduction of a pointer generation network to optimise the decoder part of the Transformer model, where both generation probability and replication probability are computed at each time step of the decoder, where the generation probability is used to generate a new word and the replication probability is used to select a word from the input sequence. Thereby, at each time step, the model can select the most appropriate word as an output based on the context and the generation/copy probability. By optimising the decoder, the performance of the model in handling the task of short text intent recognition is improved. Experimental results show the effectiveness and superiority of the method in the short text categorisation intent recognition pathway. The accuracy and performance of short text intent recognition can be improved on datasets such as SNIPS.

articleTitle: Optimization model of heliostatic field based on simulated annealing algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: This paper introduces a modified simulated annealing algorithm to study the solar helioscope field optimization problem. The algorithm combines adaptive adjustment, multi-start, and local search techniques to maximize system energy efficiency. Through flexible tuning of parameters and multiple runs, the optimal solution is found to maximize the output power. Research not only guides the development of solar collection technology, but also provides methods for evaluating the performance evaluation of solar systems in different environments. In addition, methods and models can be extended to renewable energy and photovoltaic technologies, to support broader sustainable energy research.

articleTitle: Remote sensing small object detection algorithm based on improved YOLOv8
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: Remote sensing target detection is an important link in environmental monitoring, urban planning and other fields. As far as remote sensing target detection is concerned, because it is mainly a densely distributed small target, As a result, there are instances of erroneous and missed detections during the detection procedure. Therefore, this paper proposes an improved YOLOv8 remote sensing small target detection method. Firstly, Bi-level Routing Attention (BRA) is added to enhance the network's ability to perceive small object. In addition, a Convolution to Fully Connected- Deformable Convolutional Network (C2f-DCN) module which can sample features flexibly is proposed, which has better feature extraction ability for irregular shapes and different sizes in the map of feature, thus improving the detection ability of the model for occluded overlapping targets. Then, the Spatial Pyramid Pooling-Fast-Large Separable Kernel Attention(SPPF-LSKA)module with remote dependence and adaptive capability is presented, which can reduce the interference of the background. At the same time, In order to enhance the accuracy and resilience of the model in small target detection, the original network's loss function is simultaneously optimized using the normalized Wasserstein distance (NWD) loss function.Finally, the YOLOv8 header is replaced by the Dynamic Head header, and the dynamic routing mechanism can better fuse context information, identify multi-scale targets, and dynamically adjust the weights of different feature layers, which is beneficial to extract multi-scale features. Experimental results showed that the accuracy of the DIOR and RSOD remote sensing data sets measured by the improved algorithm reached 88.4% and 96.22%, respectively.The experiment results show that the proposed algorithm can reach the detection precision of 88.4% and 96.22% on the remote sensing data sets of DIOR and RSOD.Compared to the original YOLOv8 algorithm, the detection accuracy and speed improved by 2.90% and 3.50%, respectively. Compared to other advanced algorithms, the enhenced algorithm has certain advantages in inspection accuracy and speed.

articleTitle: A Brief Review of Sign Language Recognition Methods and Cutting-edge Technologies
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: Sign Language Recognition (SLR) has acquired a considerable amount of attentions in recent years and attracted widespread interests. Sign language recognition methods have continuously evolved from traditional artificial neural networks to deep learning methods, and these methods have led to increasing accuracy in sign language recognition. Advances in sign language recognition technology have provided the deaf community with a broader communication space, while also injecting new vitality into the technology field. The majority of widely used sign language recognition methods are derived from neural networks and deep learning models, such as convolutional neural networks, recurrent neural networks and long and short-term memory networks. In recent years, the rapidly developing BEiT model is expected to be used in the realm of sign language recognition, so that it can develop more intelligent and efficient applications in the future, and make more important contributions to the barrier-free communication and exchange in the society. The aim of this paper is to summarize the methods applied in the field of sign language recognition and the cutting-edge technologies in sign language recognition.

articleTitle: Automatic recognition and parameter extraction in GPR images
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: In this paper, we propose a fast and efficient method for fitting dual-region wave recognition to GPR images under real conditions. Firstly, the GPR image is segmented into hyperpixels according to the idea of "points instead of regions". Then, a novel multi-scale neighborhood computation method is proposed to obtain the region of interest to achieve the binarization of the source image. Subsequently, skeleton extraction was performed in the region of interest by opening and closing and other algorithms. Finally, the region of hyperbolic waves is selected and its corresponding equations are obtained by matching the downward opening line segments based on the known fitting set, and the accuracy of the extraction is judged. In the proposed method, the multiscale neighborhood computation to obtain the region of interest and the final matching algorithm are its two core parts. The preliminary multi-scale neighborhood computation and the final matching algorithm take into account the geometrical characteristics of the two-region wave, which makes the algorithm more robust. The paper confirms the effectiveness of this algorithm through experiments.

articleTitle: Automatic Reference Counting Implementation and Optimization of the Octave JIT Compiler for High-Performance Computing Platforms
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: Reference counting, a venerable technique, has seen a resurgence owing to recent advancements. This resurgence holds particular significance for dynamic languages, which have historically faced constraints linked to traditional reference counting issues, thus standing to greatly benefit from these advancements. However, implementing reference counting in Just-In-Time (JIT) compilers for dynamic languages presents significant challenges. These challenges originate from two main sources: the intrinsic properties of dynamic languages and the application requirements of high-performance computing (HPC) platforms. Taking Octave, a dynamic language celebrated for its matrix computation capabilities, as a case study, we delved into and refined the memory management mechanisms of its JIT compiler. By resolving the correctness issues in these mechanisms, we shed light on the complexities surrounding the integration of automatic reference counting (ARC) algorithms from static to dynamic languages. Moreover, within the realm of HPC platforms, we emphasize the critical role of timely garbage collection for dynamic languages. Consequently, we introduce an ARC algorithm tailor-made for HPC environments, demonstrating through experiments that this algorithm effectively enhances memory management, curtails memory utilization, expedites program execution, and significantly mitigates excessive memory access across Non-Uniform Memory Access (NUMA) nodes. Our findings unveil novel strategies for memory management and JIT compilation in dynamic languages, underscoring ARC's potential to streamline complex data structure management, ease the burden on compiler developers, and boost the execution speed of dynamic languages.

articleTitle: Application of Deep Belief Network under Similarity Constraints in Feature Extraction of Image Data
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: To address the poor accuracy and integrity of feature extraction caused by the failure of mining the prevalent structures of image data during the process of feature extraction of image data, this research proposes a method of image data feature extraction based on deep belief network (DBN) under similarity constraints. More specifically, the image data information is initially marked based on the introduced DBN. Subsequently, through mining the popular structure of image data employing the nearest-neighbor graph structure, matrix optimization technology is utilized to reduce the dimensionality of the mined image data, thereby obtaining the dimensionality reduction set of image data. Lastly, the feature extraction of image data is accomplished by leveraging the wavelet packet transform technology. The experimental results indicate that the proposed method significantly improves both the accuracy and integrity of feature extraction compared with the traditional feature extraction methods for image data, conclusively demonstrating the superior feature extraction performance of the proposed method as well as its feasibility for widespread application across diverse data processing scenarios.

articleTitle: An Apriori Knowledge-based Negative Sampling Method for APT Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: Advanced cyber attack is growing rapidly and becoming more sophisticated and diverse in recent years. It is difficult to detect these attacks due to their character of stealth, specificity and persistence. GNN-based methods provide a highly promising direction for advanced cyber attack detection since the graph could capture the multi-step and long-time interval behaviors. However, GNN-based methods suffer from lack of sufficient attack samples. In this work, we propose a novel approach to construct negative samples for GNN-based detection model training. Our method could automatically construct enhanced attack graphs and provenance graph from CTI reports and system logs. We then utilize graph alignment and graph augmentation to construct attack samples by aggregating attack behavior and system behavior. The evaluation showed that our method can accurately generate realistic attack samples and effectively improve the performance of some existing detection methods.

articleTitle: GC-TopFormer: Global Context-Enhanced Token Pyramid Transformer for Semantic Segmentation on Mobile Devices
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: In the realm of computer vision, Vision Transformers (ViTs) have showcased remarkable efficacy, setting new performance benchmarks. However, substantial computational demands limit their utility in resource-constrained environments, particularly for sophisticated tasks like semantic segmentation on mobile devices. TopFormer, an architecture optimized for mobile devices, utilizes tokens from diverse scales to generate scale-informed semantic attributes, which are subsequently reinfused into the respective tokens to enhance the hierarchical features. In segmentation task, effectively modeling detail information is paramount, and a more comprehensive initial capture of detail information can get more precise results of object edges and finer details. GC-BLOCK fuses global context information into channel features to achieve more effective global context modeling during the early stages of segmentation, and is lightweight with a negligible increase in parameters. However, we find that TopFormer has limitations in the early feature extraction stage because of insufficient extraction of detailed information. To address this issue, this paper proposes a new approach: Global Context-Enhanced Token Pyramid Transformer for Semantic Segmentation on Mobile Devices (GC-TopFormer). Specifically, global context modeling is integrated between diverse scales of the token pyramid with global information being channel-wise integrated, which enables the proposed approach to effectively extract global information and perform better feature fusion. Extensive experiments on two challenging semantic segmentation datasets, ADE20K and Cityscapes, demonstrates that GC-TopFormer not only improves segmentation results and detail preservation but also maintains the lightweight nature.

articleTitle: Fine-Grained Bug Localization Based on Rich Context using Attention Tree-GRU
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Computer Engineering and Application (ICCEA)
abstract: Information retrieval(IR) based bug localization technology is a relatively recognized lightweight location method. Most IR bug localization methods solve the problem of semantic difference between natural language in the bug report(BR) and code language in source code based on semantic intelligibility, and use semantic similarity to construct IR model to directly locate source code faults through bug report. At present, most IR bug localization results are files, but this kind of location method has been questioned for its result usefulness by many articles in terms of localization granularity and form intelligibility. By observing the process of bug generation and repair in the evolution program, we propose an IR bug localization technology based on system experience and repair experience, which realizes fine-grained and interpretable bug localization in the form of Diff-Bug link. Through the relationship between diff code and bug, the source of bug in the software evolution process is explained, and the interpretability of the results in bug localization is achieved by simulating the execution path, combined with the code structure information to enrich the code semantics, and through the BERT and Attention Tree-GRU respectively to deal with the semantic representation of the two languages, using the Pseudo-Siamese Network(PSN) to guide the semantic extraction of code language with natural language semantics, solve the problem of expression differences cross languages, and achieve semantic correspondence between fine-grained code and natural language, so this method is called Interpretable bug localization (IBL). Based on the bug data set including Jena, mahout and other projects, the accuracy of IBL is better than the traditional file-level IR based bug localization method. It can not only effectively locate program faults at a fine-grained level, but also assist programmers in effectively understanding the causes of bugs.
